<content>
namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta latin:/powertypes?PowerSFOL❚

theory ClosureSystem_Eq =
	include ?ClosureSystem❙
	structure cs : ?ClosureSystem❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?ClosureSystemToCloseness; ?ClosenessToClosureOperator; ?ClosureOperatorToClosureSystem❙
	
	CC_eq : ⊦ CC =ͭ cs/CC❘ = subset_antisym 
							 (subsetI [A, p] pfilterI tforallI [x] implI [q] 
							  q pfilterE tforallE A implE pfilterI andI p tforallI [z] implI[r] r)
							 (subsetI [A, p] (subset_antisym p pfilterE subset_biginter_glb [C, q] q pfilterE andEr) 
							  tcongP ([B] B ∈ͯ CC) intersection_closed subsetI [C, q] q pfilterE andEl)❙
❚

theory Closeness_Eq =
	include ?Closeness❙
	structure cn : ?Closeness❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?ClosenessToClosureOperator; ?ClosureOperatorToClosureSystem; ?ClosureSystemToCloseness❙
	
	close_eq : {x, A} ⊦ x ⋶ A ⇔ x cn/⋶ A❘ = [x, A] equivI 
	 											 ([p] biginterI [S, q] q pfilterE andEl pfilterE tforallE x 
	 											  implE bigger_close p (q pfilterE andEr)) 
	 											 ([p] biginterE p pfilterI andI
	 											  (pfilterI tforallI [y] implI [q] pfilterI transitive_close q 
	 											   tforallI [z] implI [r] r pfilterE)
	 											  (subsetI [y, q] pfilterI in_close q) pfilterE)❙
❚

theory ClosureOperator_Eq =
	include ?ClosureOperator❙
	structure co : ?ClosureOperator❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?ClosureOperatorToClosureSystem; ?ClosureSystemToCloseness; ?ClosenessToClosureOperator❙
	
	closure_eq : {A} ⊦ cl A =ͭ co/cl A❘ = [A] subset_antisym 
											(subset_biginter_glb [S, p] subsetI [x, q] 
											 p pfilterE andEl pfilterE tforallE x implE 
											 subsetE (monotone_closure (p pfilterE andEr)) q)
											(subset_biginter pfilterI andI
											(pfilterI tforallI [x] implI [p] eq_in_left idempotent_closure p) 
											 extensive_closure)❙

❚

theory DiagramCommutes =
	include ?ClosureTopology❙
	include ?ClosedTopology❙
	structure co1 : ?ClosureOperator❘ abbrev ?ClosureOperatorToClosureSystem❙
	structure co2 : ?ClosureOperator❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?ClosureTopologyToInteriorTopology ;
										           ?InteriorTopologyToNeighborhoodTopology ;
										           ?NeighborhoodTopologyToOpenTopology ;
										           ?OpenTopologyToClosedTopology❙
								           
    diag_commutes : {A} ⊦ co1/cl A =ͭ co2/cl A❘ = [A] subset_antisym
    												(subsetI [x, p] complI [q] [a] q pfilterE pfilterE texistsE [O, r] complE
    												 (biginterE p pfilterI andI r andEl andEl pfilterE
											   		  subset_compl_right(r andEr))
											   	 (r andEl andEr) inconE)
    												(subsetI [x, p] biginterI [B, q] compl_compl tcongP ([C] x ∈ͯ C) 
    												  complI [r] complE p 
										  	       pfilterI pfilterI texistsI (∁ͯB) andI 
										  	       (andI (pfilterI (compl_compl tsym tcongP ([C] C ∈ͯ CC) (q pfilterE andEl))) r)
										            subset_compl (q pfilterE andEr))❙
❚

theory ClosedTopology_Eq =
	include ?ClosedTopology❙
	structure ct : ?ClosedTopology❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?ClosedTopologyToClosenessTopology;
												 ?ClosenessTopologyToClosureTopology;
												 ?ClosureTopologyToInteriorTopology;
												 ?InteriorTopologyToNeighborhoodTopology;
												 ?NeighborhoodTopologyToOpenTopology;
												 ?OpenTopologyToClosedTopology❙
	
	CC_subs1 : ⊦ CC ⊆ͯ ct/CC❘ = subsetI [A, p] pfilterI subsetI [x, q] 
						     compl_compl tcongP ([B] x ∈ͯ B) complI [r] complE q 
						     pfilterI pfilterI texistsI (∁ͯA) 
						     andI (andI (pfilterI (compl_compl tsym tcongP ([C] C ∈ͯ CC) p)) r) subset_refl❙
						  
	lemma1 : {x, A} ⊦ (x ∈ͯ ⋂ͯ pfilter [B] (B ∈ͯ CC ∧ A ⊆ͯ B)) ⟶ ⊦ x ∈ͯ ∁ͯ(pfilter [y] ∁ͯ(A) ∈ͯ pfilter [B] ∃ͭ[O] (O ∈ͯ pfilter[C] ∁ͯ(C) ∈ͯ CC) ∧ y ∈ͯ O ∧ O ⊆ͯ B)❘
				     = [x, A, q] complI [r] [a] r pfilterE pfilterE texistsE [O, s] complE
								(biginterE q pfilterI andI s andEl andEl pfilterE
											   		  (compl_compl tcongP ([B] B ⊆ͯ ∁ͯO) subset_compl (s andEr)))
								(s andEl andEr) inconE❙

    CC_subs2 : ⊦ ct/CC ⊆ͯ CC❘ = subsetI [A, p] (subset_antisym
							   (subsetI [x, q] subsetE p pfilterE lemma1 q)
							   (subset_biginter_glb [B, q] (q pfilterE) andEr))
							  tcongP ([B] B ∈ͯ CC) intersection_closed subsetI [B, q] q pfilterE andEl❙

    CC_eq : ⊦ CC =ͭ ct/CC❘ = subset_antisym CC_subs1 CC_subs2❙
❚

theory ClosenessTopology_Eq =
	include ?ClosenessTopology❙
	structure ct : ?ClosenessTopology❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?ClosenessTopologyToClosureTopology;
												    ?ClosureTopologyToInteriorTopology;
												    ?InteriorTopologyToNeighborhoodTopology;
												    ?NeighborhoodTopologyToOpenTopology;
												    ?OpenTopologyToClosedTopology;
												    ?ClosedTopologyToClosenessTopology❙
	
	close_impl1 : {x, A} ⊦ x ⋶ A ⇒ x ct/⋶ A❘ = [x, A] implI [p] complI [q] [a] 
													 q pfilterE pfilterE texistsE [O, r] complE
													  (r andEl andEl pfilterE pfilterE tforallE x implE
													   bigger_close p subset_compl_right (r andEr))
													  (r andEl andEr) inconE❙
													  
	close_impl2 : {x, A} ⊦ x ct/⋶ A ⇒ x ⋶ A❘ = [x, A] implI [p] indirect [q] complE p 
													 pfilterI pfilterI texistsI (∁ͯ pfilter [y] y ⋶ A)
													  andI (andI (pfilterI pfilterI tforallI [y] implI [r]
													   			  compl_compl tsym tcongP ([B] y ∈ͯ B) (pfilterI transitive_close r
													   			   tforallI [z] implI [s] compl_compl tcongP ([B] z ∈ͯ B) s pfilterE))
													    			 complI [r] q notE (r pfilterE))
													   	    subset_compl subsetI [y, r] pfilterI in_close r❙
													   	    
	close_eq : {x, A} ⊦ x ⋶ A ⇔ x ct/⋶ A❘ = [x, A] equivI ([p] close_impl1 implE p) [p] close_impl2 implE p❙
❚

theory ClosureTopology_Eq =
	include ?ClosureTopology❙
	structure ct : ?ClosureTopology❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?ClosureTopologyToInteriorTopology;
												  ?InteriorTopologyToNeighborhoodTopology;
												  ?NeighborhoodTopologyToOpenTopology;
												  ?OpenTopologyToClosedTopology;
												  ?ClosedTopologyToClosenessTopology;
												  ?ClosenessTopologyToClosureTopology❙
	
	closure_subs1 : {A} ⊦ cl A ⊆ͯ ct/cl A❘ = [A] subsetI [x, p] complI [q] [a] q pfilterE pfilterE texistsE [O, s] complE
											    (s andEl andEl pfilterE pfilterE tforallE x implE subsetE
											    	 (monotone_closure subset_compl_right (s andEr)) p)
											    (s andEl andEr) inconE❙
											    
	closure_subs2 : {A} ⊦ ct/cl A ⊆ͯ cl A❘ = [A] subsetI [x, p] indirect [q] complE p
											    pfilterI pfilterI texistsI (∁ͯ cl A)
											     andI (andI (pfilterI pfilterI tforallI [y] implI [r] 
											      			 compl_compl tsym tcongP ([B] y ∈ͯ B) eq_in_left idempotent_closure
											      			  (compl_compl tcongP ([B] y ∈ͯ cl B) r)) 
											     		    complI [r] q notE r)
											     	  subset_compl extensive_closure❙
										  
	closure_eq : {A} ⊦ cl A =ͭ ct/cl A❘ = [A] subset_antisym closure_subs1 closure_subs2❙
❚

theory InteriorTopology_Eq =
	include ?InteriorTopology❙
	structure it : ?InteriorTopology❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?InteriorTopologyToNeighborhoodTopology;
												   ?NeighborhoodTopologyToOpenTopology;
												   ?OpenTopologyToClosedTopology;
												   ?ClosedTopologyToClosenessTopology;
												   ?ClosenessTopologyToClosureTopology;
												   ?ClosureTopologyToInteriorTopology❙
	
	interior_subs1 : {A} ⊦ interior A ⊆ͯ it/interior A❘ 
						  = [A] subsetI [x, p] pfilterI pfilterI texistsI (interior A)
							    andI (andI (pfilterI pfilterI tforallI [y] implI [r]
									        eq_in_left (compl_compl tsym tcongP ([B] interior B =ͭ interior A) 
									                   (idempotent_interior tsym) tcongP
						                                ([B] ∁ͯ interior ∁ͯ∁ͯ interior A =ͭ ∁ͯB) trefl) r) 
										    p)
			                           extensive_interior❙
											    
	interior_subs2 : {A} ⊦ it/interior A ⊆ͯ interior A❘ 
						  = [A] subsetI [x, p] p pfilterE pfilterE texistsE [O, q] subsetE 
						  	    (monotone_interior (q andEr))
								indirect [s] complE 
								 (q andEl andEl pfilterE pfilterE tforallE x implE complI [r] s notE
								   (compl_compl tcongP ([B] x ∈ͯ interior B) r))
								 (q andEl andEr)❙
										  
	interior_eq : {A} ⊦ interior A =ͭ it/interior A❘ = [A] subset_antisym interior_subs1 interior_subs2❙
❚

theory NeighborhoodTopology_Eq =
	include ?NeighborhoodTopology❙
	structure nt : ?NeighborhoodTopology❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?NeighborhoodTopologyToOpenTopology;
												   	   ?OpenTopologyToClosedTopology;
												       ?ClosedTopologyToClosenessTopology;
												       ?ClosenessTopologyToClosureTopology;
												       ?ClosureTopologyToInteriorTopology;
												       ?InteriorTopologyToNeighborhoodTopology❙
	
	NN_subs1 : {x} ⊦ NN x ⊆ͯ nt/NN x❘ = [x] subsetI [A, p] pfilterI texistsI (pfilter [y] y ∶ A) andI 
										   (andI (pfilterI pfilterI tforallI [y] implI [q] complI [r] complE q
										   		   (pfilterI ((compl_compl tsym) tcongP ([B] y ∶ B)
										   		   	((openness_neighborhood (r pfilterE)) texistsE [M, s]
										   		   	 superset_closed_neighborhood ((s tforallE y) andEl)
										   		   	  (subsetI [z, t] pfilterI (((s tforallE z) andEr) implE t))))))

namespace latin:/algebraic❚

fixmeta latin:/?SFOLEQND❚

theory UnitElement =
  include ?Magma❙
  unit: U ❘# e❙
  realize ?Pointed❙
  point = unit❙
  involution : U ⟶ prop❘ = [x] x∘x =ͭ e❙
❚

theory RightUnital =
  include ?UnitElement❙
  neutralR : ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] x∘e =ͭ x❙
  neutR: {x} ⊦ x∘e =ͭ x❘= [x] neutralR tforallE x❘role Simplify❙
❚

theory LeftUnital = 
  include ?UnitElement❙
  neutralL : ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] e∘x =ͭ x❙
  neutL: {x} ⊦ e∘x =ͭ x❘= [x] neutralL tforallE x❘ role Simplify❙ 
❚

theory Unital = 
  include ?LeftUnital ❙
  include ?RightUnital ❙
❚

// Two variants of magmas in which the composition of some elements returns the first/last one that is not the neutral element.
These are rather uninteresting theories, but they are helpful in the Option monad (with None as the neutral element).
❚
theory FirstNonNeutral =
  include ?Unital❙
  firstNonNeutral : ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] x≠e ⇒ ∀ͭ[y]x∘y =ͭ x❙
  // realize ?Monoid❙
❚

theory LastNonNeutral =
  include ?Unital❙
  lastNonNeutral : ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] x≠e ⇒ ∀ͭ[y]x∘y =ͭ x❙  
  // realize ?Monoid❙
❚

theory Powers = 
  include ?PowerAssociative❙
  include ?Unital❙
  include ☞latin:/?NatLiterals❙
  power : U ⟶ ℕ ⟶ U❘# 1 ^ 2 prec 60❙
  power_zero: {x} ⊦ x^0 =ͭ e❘ role Simplify❙
  power_succ: {x,n} ⊦ x^(n') =ͭ x^n∘x❘ role Simplify❙
❚

theory Monoid = 
  include ?Semigroup❙
  include ?Unital❙

  inverse : U ⟶ U ⟶ prop❘ = [x,xˈ] x∘xˈ =ͭ e ∧ xˈ∘x =ͭ e❘# inverse 1 2 prec 30❙

  inverse_sym : {x,xˈ} ⊦ inverse x xˈ ⟶ ⊦ inverse xˈ x❘
              = [x,xˈ,p] andI (p andEr) (p andEl)❙
  inverse_unique : {x,x1,x2} ⊦ inverse x x1 ⟶ ⊦ inverse x x2 ⟶ ⊦ x1 =ͭ x2❘
                 = [x,x1,x2,p,q] eqChain x1
                 ⟪ _ ttrans (q andEl tsym tcongT [u]x1∘u) ⟫ x1∘(x∘x2)
                 ⟪ _ ⟫ (x1∘x)∘x2
                 ⟪ (p andEr tcongT [u]u∘x2) ⟫ x2❙

  inverse_neutral : ⊦ inverse e e❘
                  = andI neutL neutL❙
  inverse_op : {x,y,xˈ,yˈ} ⊦ inverse x xˈ ⟶ ⊦ inverse y yˈ ⟶ ⊦ inverse (x∘y) (yˈ∘xˈ)❘
             = [x,y,xˈ,yˈ,p,q] andI
             (assoc ttrans ((ttrans3 assocR (q andEl tcongT [u]u∘xˈ) neutL) tcongT [u]x∘u) ttrans (p andEl))
             (assoc ttrans ((ttrans3 assocR (p andEr tcongT [u]u∘y) neutL) tcongT [u]yˈ∘u) ttrans (q andEr))
             ❙

  involution_inverse: {x} ⊦ involution x ⇔ inverse x x❘
             = [x] equivI ([p] andI p p) ([p] p andEl)❙
❚

theory Involutory =
  include ?Monoid❙
  involutory: {x} ⊦ involution x❙
  
  inverse_refl : {x} ⊦ inverse x x❘
               = [x] involution_inverse equivEl involutory❙
  inverse_ident : {x,y} ⊦ inverse x y ⟶ ⊦ x =ͭ y❘
                = [x,y,p] inverse_unique inverse_refl p❙
❚

theory IdempotentMonoid = 
  include ?Monoid❙
  include ?Band❙
❚

theory CommMonoid = 
  include ?Monoid❙
  include ?CommSemigroup❙
❚

theory BoundedSemilattice =
  include ?Semilattice ❙
  include ?CommMonoid ❙
❚

namespace latin:/algebraic❚

fixmeta latin:/?SFOLEQ ❚

theory Quasigroup = 
  include ?Magma ❙
  div_left : ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] ∀ͭ[y] ∃ͭ[a] (a∘x =ͭ y) ❙
  div_right: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] ∀ͭ[y] ∃ͭ[b] (x∘b =ͭ y) ❙ 
❚

theory Loop = 
  include ?Quasigroup ❙
  include ?Monoid❙
❚

theory InverseOperator = 
  include ?Semigroup❙
  inv : U ⟶ U❘# 1 ⁻ prec 60❙
  is_weak_inverse : U ⟶ U ⟶ prop❘
                  = [x,y] x∘y∘x =ͭ x ∧ y∘x∘y =ͭ y❘# %n 1 2 prec 30❙
❚

/T weaker variant of unique inverse element, formulated without neutral element
   usually union of X and WeakInverse usually called InverseX in the literature❚
theory WeakInverse = 
  include ?InverseOperator❙
  weak_inverse : ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] is_weak_inverse x (x⁻)❙
❚

theory InverseFun = 
  include ?Monoid❙
  include ?InverseOperator❙

  inverseLeft:  ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] x⁻∘x =ͭ e❙
  inverseRight: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] x∘x⁻ =ͭ e❙
  
  div : U ⟶ U ⟶ U❘= [x,y]x∘y⁻❙
  
  invL : {x} ⊦ x⁻∘x =ͭ e❘= [x] inverseLeft tforallE x❙
  invR : {x} ⊦ x∘x⁻ =ͭ e❘= [x] inverseRight tforallE x❙
  
  inverse_inv : {x} ⊦ inverse x (x⁻)❘= [x] andI invR invL❙
  inv_unit : ⊦ e⁻ =ͭ e❘ = inverse_unique (?InverseFun?inverse_inv e) inverse_neutral❙
  inv_inv : {x} ⊦ x⁻⁻ =ͭ x❘  = [x] inverse_unique inverse_inv (inverse_sym inverse_inv)❙
  inv_op : {x,y} ⊦ (x∘y)⁻ =ͭ y⁻∘x⁻❘
         = [x,y] inverse_unique inverse_inv (inverse_op inverse_inv inverse_inv)❙
❚

theory InverseExistence = 
  include ?Monoid ❙
  inverseLeft:  ⊦ ∀ͭ[x]∃ͭ[i] i∘x =ͭ e ❙
  inverseRight: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x]∃ͭ[i] x∘i =ͭ e ❙
❚

theory Group = 
  include ?Monoid ❙
  include ?InverseFun ❙
❚

theory CommGroup = 
  include ?Group❙
  include ?CommMonoid❙
❚

theory GroupHom = 
  include ?MagmaHom ❙
  structure domain : ?Group =
    U = domain/U ❙
  ❚
  structure codoamin : ?Group = 
    U = codomain/U ❙
  ❚
  // e: ⊦ U domain/e ≐ codomain/e ❙
❚

namespace latin:/algebraic❚

/T regular bands and views between them
mostly following the wikipedia page on Bands

Notes: 
- some names that were not given on Wikipedia are made up
- most views do not actually use (all of) the Band properties
- LeftX and RightX are stronger than X, not weaker
❚

fixmeta latin:/?SFOLEQND❚

theory Regular =
	include ?Band ❙
  regular: {x,y,z} ⊦ z∘x∘z∘y∘z =ͭ z∘x∘y∘z ❙
❚

theory LeftNormal =
	include ?Band ❙
  leftregular1: {x,y,z} ⊦ z∘x∘z∘y =ͭ z∘x∘y ❙
❚

theory LeftRegular =
	include ?Band ❙
  leftregular: {x,z} ⊦ z∘x∘z =ͭ z∘x ❙
❚

theory RightNormal =
	include ?Band ❙
  rightregular1: {x,y,z} ⊦ x∘z∘y∘z =ͭ x∘y∘z ❙
❚

theory RightRegular =
	include ?Band ❙
  rightregular: {y,z} ⊦ z∘y∘z =ͭ y∘z ❙
❚

/T views for the three stages of regular band theories ❚

implicit view Regular2LeftNormal : ?Regular -> ?LeftNormal =
  include ?Band❙
	regular = [x,y,z] leftregular1 tcongT [u]u∘z❙
❚

implicit view LeftNormal2LeftRegular : ?LeftNormal -> ?LeftRegular =
  include ?Band❙
	leftregular1 = [x,y,z] leftregular tcongT [u]u∘y❙
❚

implicit view Regular2RightNormal : ?Regular -> ?RightNormal =
  include ?Band❙
	regular = [x,y,z] ttrans3 assoc5 ((ttrans3 assoc4R rightregular1 assoc) tcongT [u]z∘u) assoc4R❙
❚

implicit view RightNormal2RightRegular : ?RightNormal -> ?RightRegular =
  include ?Band❙
	rightregular1 = [x,y,z] ttrans3 assoc4 ((assocR ttrans rightregular) tcongT [u] x∘u) assocR❙
❚

/T normal bands ❚

theory Normal =
	include ?Band ❙
  normal: {x,y,z} ⊦ z∘(x∘y)∘z =ͭ z∘(y∘x)∘z ❙
❚

theory RightCommutative =
	include ?Band ❙
  leftnormal: {x,y,z} ⊦ z∘(x∘y) =ͭ z∘(y∘x) ❙
❚

theory LeftCommutative =
	include ?Band ❙
  rightnormal: {x,y,z} ⊦ (x∘y)∘z =ͭ (y∘x)∘z ❙
❚

/T views for the diamond of normal band theories (with semilattices at the bottom) ❚

implicit view Normal2RightCommutative : ?Normal -> ?RightCommutative =
  include ?Band❙
	normal = [x,y,z] leftnormal tcongT [u]u∘z❙
❚

implicit view Normal2LeftCommutative : ?Normal -> ?LeftCommutative =
  include ?Band❙
	normal = [x,y,z] ttrans3 assoc (rightnormal tcongT [u]z∘u) assocR❙
❚

view RightCommutative2Semilattice : ?RightCommutative -> ?Semilattice =
  include ?Band❙
	leftnormal = [x,y,z] comm tcongT [u]z∘u❙
❚

implicit view LeftCommutative2Semilattice : ?LeftCommutative -> ?Semilattice =
  include ?Band❙
	rightnormal = [x,y,z] comm tcongT [u]u∘z❙
❚

/T views from regular to normal band theories ❚

implicit view LeftNormal2Normal : ?LeftNormal -> ?Normal =
  include ?Band❙
  // zxzy = zxzyzxzy = zx yz zxzy = zxy zx zy = zxy xz zy = zxy zxy = zxy❙
  leftregular1 = [x,y,z]
     assoc ttrans (idem tsym)
     ttrans
     assocR ttrans (at ([u] u∘(z∘y)) tcongT normal ttrans assoc)
     ttrans
     (assoc4M ttrans (idem tcongT [u]y∘u∘x) tcongT [u] (z∘x)∘u∘(z∘y))
     ttrans
     assoc ttrans (at ([u] (z∘x)∘u) tcongT (assoc tcongT [u] u∘(z∘y)) ttrans assoc4M ttrans normal)
     ttrans
     (assocR ttrans (idem tcongT [u]u∘x) tcongT [u] (z∘x)∘((y∘u)∘y))
     ttrans
     (assoc tcongT [u] (z∘x)∘u) ttrans assocR
     ttrans
     idem
    ❙
❚

implicit view LeftRegular2RightCommutative : ?LeftRegular -> ?RightCommutative =
  include ?Band❙
	leftregular = [x,z] ttrans4 assoc leftnormal assocR (idem tcongT [u]u∘x)❙
❚

implicit view RightNormal2Normal : ?RightNormal -> ?Normal =
  include ?Band❙
  	rightregular1 = [x,y,z]
     assoc ttrans (idem tsym)
     ttrans
     assoc ttrans ((assocR ttrans normal) tcongT [u] (x∘z)∘u)
     ttrans
     (at ([u] (x∘z)∘(u∘(y∘z))) tcongT (assoc4M ttrans (idem tcongT [u]y∘u∘x)))
     ttrans
     assocR ttrans ((assoc4M ttrans normal) tcongT [u] u∘(y∘z))
     ttrans
     (at ([u] ((x∘u)∘x)∘(y∘z)) tcongT (assoc ttrans (idem tcongT [u]y∘u)))
     ttrans
     assoc ttrans idem ttrans assocR❙
❚

implicit view RightRegular2LeftCommutative : ?RightRegular -> ?LeftCommutative =
  include ?Band❙
	rightregular = [y,z] ttrans3 rightnormal assoc (idem tcongT [u]y∘u)❙
❚

/T rectangular bands (the axioms here already imply idempotency)❚

theory Rectangular =
	include ?Band ❙
  rectangular: {x,y} ⊦ x∘y∘x =ͭ x ❙
  
  // provable ❙
  rectangularAny: {x,y,z} ⊦ x∘y∘z =ͭ x∘z❙
❚

theory LeftZero =
	include ?Band ❙
  leftzero: {x,y} ⊦ x∘y =ͭ x ❙
❚

theory RightZero =
	include ?Band ❙
  rightzero: {x,y} ⊦ x∘y =ͭ y ❙
❚

namespace latin:/algebraic❚

fixmeta latin:/?SFOLEQND❚

theory DivGroup =
	include ?Set❙
	
	e : U❙
	div : U ⟶ U ⟶ U ❘# 1 ÷ 2 prec 50❙
	
	self_div : {x} ⊦ x ÷ x =ͭ e❙
	unit_neutR : {x} ⊦ x ÷ e =ͭ x❙
	reciprocal : {x, y} ⊦ e ÷ (x ÷ y) =ͭ y ÷ x❙
	reduce : {x, y, z} ⊦ (x ÷ z) ÷ (y ÷ z) =ͭ x ÷ y❙  
❚

view GroupToDivGroup : ?Group → ?DivGroup =
    include ?Set❙
    unit = e❙
    op = [x, y] x ÷ (e ÷ y)❙
    inv = [x] e ÷ x❙

    assoc_ax = tforallI [x] tforallI [y] tforallI [z] 
    		   unit_neutR tcongP 
    		   ([u] x ÷ (e ÷ y) ÷ u =ͭ x ÷ (e ÷ y) ÷ (e ÷ z ÷ e)) trefl
    		   ttrans (reduce tcongP 
    		   ([u] x ÷ (e ÷ y) ÷ u =ͭ x ÷ (e ÷ y) ÷ (e ÷ z ÷ y ÷ (e ÷ y))) trefl) 
    		   ttrans reduce 
    		   ttrans (reciprocal tcongP ([u] x ÷ u =ͭ x ÷ (e ÷ (y ÷ (e ÷ z)))) trefl)  ❙
    neutralL = tforallI [x] reciprocal ttrans unit_neutR❙
    neutralR = tforallI [x] unit_neutR tsym tcongP ([u] x ÷ u =ͭ x) unit_neutR❙
    inverseLeft = tforallI [x] self_div❙
    inverseRight = tforallI [x] reciprocal tsym tcongP ([u] x ÷ u =ͭ e) 
     							(unit_neutR tsym tcongP ([u] x ÷ u =ͭ e) self_div)❙
❚

view DivGroupToGroup : ?DivGroup → ?Group =
	include ?Set❙
	e = e❙
	div = [x, y] x∘y⁻❙
	
	self_div = [x] invR❙
	unit_neutR = [x] inv_unit tsym tcongP ([u] x∘u =ͭ x) neutR❙
	reciprocal = [x, y] inv_op ttrans ((inv_inv tsym) tcongP ([u] u∘x⁻ =ͭ y∘x⁻) trefl)❙
	reduce = [x, y, z] (inv_op tsym) tcongP ([u] x∘z⁻∘u=ͭx∘y⁻) (assoc4M ttrans 
					   (invR tsym tcongP ([u] x∘u∘y⁻ =ͭ x∘y⁻)(neutL tcongP ([u] x∘u =ͭ x∘y⁻) trefl)))❙
❚

theory GroupToGroup_Eq =
	include ?Group❙
	structure g : ?Group❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?GroupToDivGroup; ?DivGroupToGroup❙
	
	unit_eq : ⊦ unit =ͭ g/unit❘ = trefl❙
	op_eq : {x, y} ⊦ x∘y =ͭ x g/∘ y❘ = [x,y] inv_inv tcongP ([u] x∘u =ͭ x∘y⁻⁻) trefl❙
	inv_eq : {x} ⊦ (x⁻ =ͭ x g/⁻)❘ = [x] trefl❙
❚

theory DivGroupToDivGroup_Eq =
	include ?DivGroup❙
	structure d : ?DivGroup❘ abbrev COMPOSE ?DivGroupToGroup; ?GroupToDivGroup❙

	e_eq : ⊦ e =ͭ d/e❘ = trefl❙
	div_eq : {x, y} ⊦x÷y=ͭx d/÷ y❘ = [x, y] reciprocal ttrans unit_neutR tcongP 
	 										([u] x ÷ u =ͭ x÷(e÷(e÷y))) trefl❙
❚

view InfimumIsSemilattice : ?Semilattice → ?Order + ?Infimum =
  include ?Set❙
  op = inf❙
  assoc_ax = tforallI [x]tforallI [y]tforallI [z] antisym
    (infimumE infimum_ax
      (infimum_smallerL trans infimum_smallerL)
      (infimumE infimum_ax (infimum_smallerL trans infimum_smallerR) infimum_smallerR))
    (infimumE infimum_ax
      (infimumE infimum_ax infimum_smallerL (infimum_smallerR trans infimum_smallerL))
      (infimum_smallerR trans infimum_smallerR))❙
  comm_ax = tforallI [x] tforallI [y] antisym
    (infimumE infimum_ax infimum_smallerR infimum_smallerL)
    (infimumE infimum_ax infimum_smallerR infimum_smallerL)❙
  idem_ax = tforallI [x] antisym (infimum_ax andEl andEl) (infimumE infimum_ax refl refl) ❙
❚

view CartesianIsBoundedSemilattice : ?BoundedSemilattice → ?Cartesian =
  include ?InfimumIsSemilattice❙
  unit = top❙
  neutralL = tforallI [x] antisym infimum_smallerR (infimumE infimum_ax top_ax refl)❙
  neutralR = tforallI [x] antisym infimum_smallerL (infimumE infimum_ax refl top_ax)❙

<content>
// Experimental deep embedding of algebra theories, to eventually formalize theorems of universal algebra.

   Author: Navid Roux
   Date: started 2021-11-08

   The work is based on:

   [DeM21] William DeMeo. “The Agda Universal Algebra Library and Birkhoff’s Theorem in Dependent Type Theory”.
           In: CoRR abs/2101.10166 (2021). source code: https://gitlab.com/ualib/ualib.gitlab.io.
           url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.10166.

   See also Navid's review of that in their M.Sc. thesis (when it's ready) in the chapter
   "Operators for Universal Algebra".
❚
namespace latin:/algebraic/univalg-test ❚
import lfx http://gl.mathhub.info/MMT/LFX ❚

theory Meta : ur:?LF =
  include ☞lfx:/Records?LFRecords ❙
  include ☞lfx:/Finite?LFFinite ❙
  include ☞lfx:/TypedHierarchy?LFHierarchy ❙
  include ☞lfx:/WTypes?Inductive ❙
❚
fixmeta ?Meta ❚

theory Base =
  // untyped signatures of function symbols ❙
  theory UFunSig_ =
    // LF type of function symbols ❙
    F: type ❙
    // arities of the function symbols ❙
    ar: F ⟶ type ❘ # | 1 | ❙
  ❚
  // typed signatures of function symbols ❙
  theory TFunSig_ =
    include ?Base/UFunSig_ ❙
    // LF-type of object types ❙
    T: type ❙
    // object types of the function parameters for every function symbol

       Every function symbol `f: F` and argument index `a: ar f` gives the object type `argtp f i` of that very
       argument. ❙
    argtp: {f: F} |f| ⟶ T ❘ # ⟨ 1 , 2 ⟩ ❙
    // return ("_res_ult") object type for every function symbol ❙
    restp: F ⟶ T ❙
  ❚

  view EveryUntypedFunSigIsTypedOne : ?Base/TFunSig_ -> ?Base/UFunSig_ =
    include ?Base/UFunSig_ ❙
    T = UNIT ❙
    argtp = [f, a] ★ ❙
    restp = [f] ★ ❙
  ❚

  // LF types of signatures ❙
  UFunSig = Mod ☞?Base/UFunSig_ ❙
  TFunSig = Mod ☞?Base/TFunSig_ ❙

  theory UFunMod_ > sig: UFunSig ❘ =
    // redefine a notation for sig . ar because notations are not kept with the Mod operator ❙
    ar = sig . ar ❘ # | 1 | ❙

    // the model's universe ❙
    U: type ❘ # 𝕌 ❙
    // the type of argument sets for every function symbol ❙
    argset: sig . F ⟶ type ❘ = [f] |f| ⟶ 𝕌 ❙
    // the model's interpretation for every function symbol

       For every function symbol `f: sig . F`, the function `args: (sig . ar) f ⟶ univ`
       encodes a set of arguments, for which this model ought to interpret "f applied to it".❙
    interp: {f: sig . F} argset f ⟶ 𝕌 ❙
    interp_shorthand = [f] interp f ❘ # ⟦ 1 ⟧ ❙
  ❚
  theory TFunMod_ > sig: TFunSig ❘ =
    // redefine a notation for sig . ar because notations are not kept with the Mod operator ❙
    ar = sig . ar ❘ # | 1 | ❙

namespace latin:/algebraic ❚

fixmeta latin:/?SFOLEQ ❚

theory BiMagma = 
  include ?Set ❙
  structure add : ?Magma = 
    universe = universe ❙
    U = U ❙
    op # 1 + 2 prec 40 ❙
  ❚
  
  structure mult : ?Magma = 
    universe = universe ❙
    U = U ❙
    op # 1 ⋅ 2 prec 50 ❙
  ❚
❚

theory Ringoid =
  include ?BiMagma ❙
  left_distrib: ⊦ ∀ͭ[r]∀ͭ[x]∀ͭ[y] r⋅(x+y) =ͭ r⋅x + r⋅y ❙
  right_distrib: ⊦ ∀ͭ[r]∀ͭ[x]∀ͭ[y] (x+y)⋅r =ͭ x⋅r + y⋅r ❙
❚

theory CommRingoid =
  include ?Ringoid ❙
  structure mult : ?CommSemigroup =
    include ?BiMagma/mult ❙
  ❚
❚

theory MonoidalRingoid =
  include ?Ringoid❙
  structure add : ?Monoid = 
    include ?BiMagma?add❙
    constant unit # zero❙
  ❚
❚

theory BiMonoid =
  include ?MonoidalRingoid❙
  structure mult : ?Monoid = 
    include ?BiMagma?mult❙
    unit # one❙
  ❚
❚

theory NonZeroInvertible =
  include ?BiMonoid❙
  multinverse : ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] ¬x =ͭ zero ⇒ ∃ͭ[y] mult/inverse x y❙
❚

theory NoZeroDividers =  
  include ?BiMonoid ❙
  no_zero_div: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x]∀ͭ[y] (x⋅y =ͭ zero) ⇒ ((x =ͭ zero) ∨ (y =ͭ zero)) ❙
❚

theory NonTrivialRing =
  include ?BiMonoid❙
  neq01: ⊦ ¬(zero =ͭ one)❙
❚

theory Semiring = 
	include ?BiMonoid❙
	structure add : ?CommMonoid =                                                                   
	  include ?MonoidalRingoid/add ❙
	❚
❚

theory CommSemiring = 
  include ?Semiring ❙
  include ?CommRingoid ❙
❚

theory NearRing = 
  include ?BiMonoid❙
  structure add : ?Group =
    include ?MonoidalRingoid/add ❙
    inv # - 1 prec 45❙
    div # 1 - 2 prec 40❙
  ❚
❚

theory CommNearRing = 
  include ?NearRing ❙
  include ?CommRingoid ❙
❚

theory Ring = 
  include ?NearRing❙
  // realize ?Semiring❙
  structure add : ?CommGroup =
    include ?NearRing/add ❙
  ❚
❚

theory BooleanRing = 
  include ?Ring ❙
  structure mult : ?IdempotentMonoid =
    include ?BiMonoid/mult❙
  ❚
❚

theory CommRing = 
  include ?Ring ❙
  include ?CommRingoid ❙
❚

theory IntegralDomain =  
  include ?CommRing ❙
  include ?NoZeroDividers❙
❚

theory SkewField = 
  include ?Ring ❙
  include ?NonZeroInvertible❙
  include ?NonTrivialRing❙
❚

theory Field = 
  include ?SkewField ❙
  include ?CommRingoid ❙
❚

theory BilinearRingoid = 
  include ?Ringoid ❙
  f: U ⟶ U ⟶ U ❙
  bilinear: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x]∀ͭ[y]∀ͭ[z] (f (x+y) z) =ͭ (f x z) + (f y z) ∧ (f x (y+z)) =ͭ (f x y) + (f y z) ❙
  homogen: ⊦ ∀ͭ[r]∀ͭ[x]∀ͭ[y] f (r⋅x) y =ͭ r⋅ (f x y) ∧ f x (r⋅y) =ͭ r⋅(f x y) ❙
❚

theory LieRing =
  include ?Ring❙
  include ?BilinearRingoid ❙

  bracket = f ❘# ⟨ 1  2 ⟩ prec 40 ❙ 
  bracket_defn: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x]∀ͭ[y] ⟨x y⟩ =ͭ x⋅y - y⋅x ❙
  jacobi: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x]∀ͭ[y]∀ͭ[z] ⟨x ⟨y z⟩⟩ + ⟨y ⟨z x⟩⟩ + ⟨z ⟨x y⟩⟩ =ͭ zero ❙
  alternating: ⊦ ∀ͭ[x] ⟨x x⟩ =ͭ zero ❙

namespace latin:/algebraic❚

fixmeta latin:/?SFOLEQND❚
 
theory MeetSemilattice =
  include ?Set❙
  structure meet : ?Semilattice =
    include ?Set❙
    op # 1 ⊓ 2 prec 50❙
  ❚
❚

theory JoinSemilattice =
  include ?Set❙
  structure join : ?Semilattice =
  include ?Set❙
    op # 1 ⊔ 2 prec 50❙
  ❚
❚

theory BoundedMeetSemilattice =
  include ?MeetSemilattice❙
  structure bmeet : ?Monoid =
    include ?Semigroup❘ = ?MeetSemilattice?meet❙
    unit # ⊤❙
  ❚
❚

theory BoundedJoinSemilattice =
  include ?JoinSemilattice❙
  structure bjoin : ?Monoid =
    include ?Semigroup❘ = ?JoinSemilattice?join❙
    unit # ⊥❙
  ❚
❚

theory LatticeAlgebra = 
  include ?MeetSemilattice❙
  include ?JoinSemilattice❙
  absorbtion_meet_join: {x,y} ⊦ x⊓(x⊔y) =ͭ x❙
  absorbtion_join_meet: {x,y} ⊦ x⊔(x⊓y) =ͭ x❙
  
  /T Each semilattice induces a preorder. These are dual:❙
  absorbRelationsDual1 : {x,y} ⊦ meet/absorbRelation/rel x y ⟶ ⊦ join/absorbRelation/rel y x❘
   = [x,y,p] meet/comm ttrans p tsym tcongT ([u]y⊔u) ttrans absorbtion_join_meet ❙
  absorbRelationsDual2 : {x,y} ⊦ join/absorbRelation/rel x y ⟶ ⊦ meet/absorbRelation/rel y x❘
   = [x,y,p] join/comm ttrans p tsym tcongT ([u]y⊓u) ttrans absorbtion_meet_join ❙

  /T more generally, this yields a commuting diagram of
     Preorder -Semilattice?absorbRelation meet-> LatticeAlgebra and
     Preorder -Semilattice?absorbRelation join-> LatticeAlgebra
     OppositePreorder
     The diagram commutes only up to a logical equality relation that treats uses equivalence of predicates as equality❙

  /T We pick one of the morphisms to make this an Order:❙
  realize ?Order❘ = ?MeetSemilattice?meet/absorbRelation❙
  realize ?Infimum❘ = ?MeetSemilattice?meet/absorbRelationInfimum❙
  // the following fails due to incompleteness in MMT: it does not recognize the two morphisms mentioned as as equal❙
  // realize ?Supremum❘ = COMPOSE ?OppositeSup ; ?JoinSemilattice?join/absorbRelationInfimum❙

  /T An auxiliary constant to attach the usual notation.❙   
  leq = meet/absorbRelation/rel❘ # 1 ≤ 2 prec 30❙ 
❚

theory BoundedLatticeAlgegra =
  include ?LatticeAlgebra❙
  include ?BoundedMeetSemilattice❙
  include ?BoundedJoinSemilattice❙
❚

/T namespace http://latin.omdoc.org/foundations/lutins❚
namespace latin:/❚

import rules scala://imps.mmt.kwarc.info❚

/T   The underlying logic for IMPS is called LUTINS (Logic of Undefined
Terms for Inference in a Natural Style). This Higher-Order-Logic
incorporates partial functions, undefinedness and subtyping.

More details can be found at http://imps.mcmaster.ca/manual/node12.html❚

theory Lutins : http://cds.omdoc.org/urtheories?LF =

    rule rules?IntLiterals❙
    rule rules?RatLiterals❙

    # Type System❙

    /T Lutins types (which are technically just maximal sorts)
       are represented as LF terms of type "tp".❙
    tp : type❙
    
    /T Sorts refine types. They cannot be empty, but they may
       overlap. A sort that refines type A is represented as
       an LF term of the type "sort A"❙
    sort : tp ⟶ type❙
    
    /T Every expression can have many sorts, but only one type.
       That type (i.e. maximal sort) is the unique type b such that the expression's
       sort a is ≺ b. with respect to the enclosing sort relation ≺.❙
   exp : {A : tp} sort A ⟶ type❘# exp 2 prec -1❙

   /T Function types are only needed to keep track of the type of function sorts.❙
   funType: tp ⟶ tp ⟶ tp❙
   
   /T Sorts are formed from the base types and by using function sorts.
      All functions are partial.
      The function sort constructor is actually.❙
   top: {A : tp} sort A❘# ' 1❙
   fun: {A, B} sort A ⟶ sort B ⟶ sort (funType A B)❘# 3 ⇒ 4 prec 50❙
   
   /T LUTINS has primitive booleans, often called ★ in documentation.❙
   boolType : tp❙
   bool = ' boolType❙
   
   /T λ-abstractions❙
   lambda : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} (exp α ⟶ exp β) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ β)❘# λ 5❙
   
   /T You can apply a function to any argument that refines the given type.
      This will always be well-sorted but may still be undefined.❙
   apply : {A, B, α : sort A, γ : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp γ ⟶ exp β❘# 6 @ 7 prec 100❙
      
   /T The description operator ι returns the _unique_ object (of kind ι)
      if such an object exists. Otherwise, it is undefined.❙
   description_i : {A, α : sort A} (exp α ⟶ exp bool) ⟶ exp α❘# ι 3 ❙
   
   /T There's a second unique description operator for kind ★, 
      though little supported and hardly ever used. The difference being, 
      when this predicate isn't uniquely witnessed, the expression
      is not undefined, but actually false.❙
   description_p : {α : sort boolType} (exp α ⟶ exp bool) ⟶ exp α❘# ι★ 2❙
   
   /T An ordinary if-then-else operator. Branches can be undefined.❙
   ifthenelse : {A, α : sort A} exp bool ⟶ exp α ⟶ exp α ⟶ exp α❘# if 3 then 4 else 5❙

   /T A theorem is a (boolean) expression T for which there exists a proof
       (that is, an LF-term of type ⊢ T).❙
   thm : exp bool ⟶ type❘# ⊢ 1 prec -1 ❘ role Judgment❙

   /T A generic undefined Term, independent of sort.
      Equal to false in ★, since booleans must always be defined.
      Undefined functions mapping into ★ are treated as if the returned false.❙
   bottom : {A, α : sort A} exp α❘# ? 2❙
   
    # Logic❙
   
    /T Standard stuff, no surprises here.❙
   
   thetrue  : exp bool❘# TT❙
   thefalse : exp bool❘# FF❙
   
   not      : exp bool ⟶ exp bool❘# ¬ 1 prec 40❙
   
   and      : exp bool ⟶ exp bool ⟶ exp bool❘# 1 ∧ 2 prec 30❙
   or       : exp bool ⟶ exp bool ⟶ exp bool❘# 1 ∨ 2 prec 30❙
   implies  : exp bool ⟶ exp bool ⟶ exp bool❘# 1 ⊃ 2 prec 30❙
   
   iff      : exp bool ⟶ exp bool ⟶ exp bool❘# 1 ⇔ 2 prec 30❙
   
   if_form  : exp bool ⟶ exp bool ⟶ exp bool ⟶ exp bool❘# ifform 1 then 2 else 3❘
            = [p,t,e] if p then t else e❙
   
   forall   : {A, α : sort A} (exp α ⟶ exp bool) ⟶ exp bool❘# ∀ 3 prec 20❙
   forsome  : {A, α : sort A} (exp α ⟶ exp bool) ⟶ exp bool❘# ∃ 3 prec 20❙
   

   
   /T Equality takes two expressions of the same type, though
      not necessarily the same sort. Evaluates to false if either
      argument is undefined. If this is inconvenient, consider quasi-equality.❙
   equals   : {A, α : sort A, β : sort A} exp α ⟶ exp β ⟶ exp bool❘# 4 = 5 prec 50❙
   
   isdefinedin : {A, α : sort A} exp α ⟶ sort A ⟶ exp bool❘# 3 ↓ 4 prec 95❙
   
   isdefined   : {A, α : sort A} exp α ⟶ exp bool❘# 3 ↓ prec 100❘
               = [A,a,x] x↓a❙
               
   /T α being a subsort of β means everyting in α is also defined in β.❙
   subsort     : {A} sort A ⟶ sort A ⟶ exp bool❘# 2 ≤ 3 prec 50❘
               = [A,a,b] ∀ [x : exp a] x↓b❙
   
   # Quasi-Constructors❙
   
   /T Quasi-Equality also holds, even if either (!) term is undefined.❙
   quasiequals : {A, α : sort A, β : sort A} exp α ⟶ exp β ⟶ exp bool❘# 4 ≃ 5 prec 50❘
               = [A,a,b,x,y] (x↓ ∨ y↓) ⊃ x = y❙
               
   /T Predicate for checking a function for totality.❙
   totality    : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp bool❘# total 5❘
               = [A,B,a,b,f] ∀[x: exp a] ((f@x)↓)❙
         
   /T A meta-predicate that checks if a predicate is empty.❙
   nonvacuous  : {A, α : sort A} exp (α ⇒ bool) ⟶ exp bool❘# nonvacuous 3❘
               = [A,a,p] ∃[x : exp a]p@x❙
               
   /T A predicate for testing if a function is defined at an argument.❙
   domain      : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ bool)❘# domain 5❘
               = [A,B,a,b,f] λ [x] (f@x)↓❙
               
  /T IMPS also uses a quasi-constructor falselike, which takes an eventually-boolean-valued
     sort and returns the expression of that sort that returns false. This can be used to
     avoid functions that returns undefined booleans. It is not used in the library though.❙
         
  // This actually isn't in LUTINS, but it's apparently helpful for dealing with ι.❙
  forone       : {A, α : sort A} (exp α ⟶ exp bool) ⟶ exp bool❘# forone 3 prec 20❘
               = [A,a,F] ∃[x] F x ∧ (∀ [y] F y ⊃ x = y)❙
               
  # Individuals❙
  
  /T Like booleans, the type of individuals (and also a unit sort) are built-in.❙
  indType : tp❙
  unitsort @ ind ❘: sort indType ❘ = ' indType❙
  
  anIndividual : exp unitsort❙
  
  unitsortElem : ⊢ ∀ [x : exp unitsort] x = anIndividual❙
  
  /T Subsets of a sort are partial functions into the unit sort.❙
  sets : {A, α : sort A} sort (funType A indType)❘# sets [ 2 ]❘
       = [A, a] (a ⇒ unitsort)❙

  # Numeric Types❙
  
  integerType  : sort indType❘# ℤ❙
  rationalType : sort indType❘# ℚ❙
  octetType    : sort indType❘# ⑧❙
❚

theory LutinsUndefinedness : http://latin.omdoc.org/foundations/lutins?Lutins =
    include ?NonDenotingND❙
    include ?UndefinedND❙

    bottom_is_undef : ⊦ (? ↑)❙

    /T Booleans and Definedness ❙
    bool_is_def : { b : exp bool } ⊦ (b ↓)❙

❚

theory LutinsProofs : http://latin.omdoc.org/foundations/lutins?Lutins =

  magic : {e : exp bool} ⊢ e❘# ✓❙

  /T proofof : exp bool -> type❙
  /T proves  : {φ : exp bool} (⊢ φ) -> proofof φ

  # See IMPS manual pg. 208 ❙
  /T ant_inf_imp : { ψ : exp bool, φ : exp bool, ϑ : exp bool } (ψ proves ϑ) ⟶ ((¬ φ) proves ϑ) ⟶ ((φ ⊃ ψ) proves ϑ) ❙
❚
  
theory QuasiLutins : http://latin.omdoc.org/foundations/lutins?Lutins =

  include ?LutinsProofs❙

  # User-defined Quasi-Constructors❙
  # Found in indicators.t❙
  
  /T "lambda(s:[uu,prop], lambda(x:uu, if(s(x), an%individual, ?unit%sort)))"❙
  pred2indicQC : {U, υ : sort U} exp (υ ⇒ bool) ⟶ exp (sets[υ])❘# pred2indic 3❘
               = [U,υ,s] λ [x : exp υ] if (s @ x) then anIndividual else (? unitsort)❙
               
  /T "lambda(e:uu, lambda(x:uu, an%individual))"❙
  sort2indicQC : {A, α : sort A} exp α ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ❘# sort2indic 2 3❘
               = [U,a,e] λ [x : exp a] anIndividual❙
  
  /T "lambda(x:uu,a:sets[uu], #(a(x)))"❙
  inQC : {A, α : sort A} exp α ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool ❘# 3 in 4❘
       = [U,u,x,a] (a @ x) ↓ ❙
       
  /T "lambda(a,b:sets[uu], forall(x:uu, (x in a) implies (x in b)))"❙
  subseteqQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# 3 subseteq 4❘
             = [U,u,a,b] ∀ [x : exp u] ((x in a) ⊃ (x in b))❙
             
  /T "lambda(a,b:sets[uu], (a subseteq b) and not(a = b))" ❙
  subsetQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# 3 subset 4❘
           = [U,u,a,b] ((a subseteq b) ∧ (¬(a = b)))❙
  
  /T "lambda(e:uu, lambda(x:uu,?unit%sort))"❙
  emptyIndicQC : {A, α : sort A} (exp (sets[α]))❘# empty_indic 2❘
               = [U,e] λ [x: exp e] (? unitsort)❙
               
  /T "lambda(a:sets[uu], forsome(x:uu, x in a))"❙
  nonEmptyIndicQQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# nonempty_indic_q 3❘
                   = [U,u,a] ∃ [x : exp u] (x in a)❙
                   
  /T "lambda(a:sets[uu], forall(x:uu, not(x in a)))"❙
  emptyIndicQQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# empty_indic_q 3❘
                = [U,u,a] ∀ [x : exp u] ¬(x in a)❙
                
  /T "lambda(s:sets[uu], indic(x:uu, (not #(s(x)))))"❙
  complementQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# 3 ^^❘
               = [U,u,s] pred2indic (λ [x : exp u] (¬((s @ x)↓)))❙
               
  /T "lambda(s,t:sets[uu], indic(x:uu, #(s(x)) or #(t(x))))"❙
  unionQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# 3 union 4❘
          = [U,u,s,t] pred2indic (λ [x : exp u] ((s @ x)↓ ∨ (t @ x)↓))❙
          
  /T "lambda(s,t:sets[uu], indic(x:uu, #(s(x)) or #(t(x))))"❙
  intersectionQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# 3 intersection 4❘
                 = [U,u,s,t] pred2indic (λ [x : exp u] ((s @ x)↓ ∧ (t @ x)↓))❙
         
  /T "lambda(s,t:sets[uu], indic(x:uu, #(s(x)) and (not #(t(x)))))"❙
  differenceQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# 3 diff 4❘
               = [U,u,s,t] pred2indic (λ [x : exp u]  (s @ x)↓ ∧ ¬ (t @ x)↓)❙
               
  /T "lambda(s,t:sets[uu], 
                 indic(x:uu, (#(s(x)) and (not #(t(x)))) or ((not #(s(x))) and #(t(x)))))"❙
  symDifferenceQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# 3 sym_diff 4❘
                  = [U,u,s,t] pred2indic (λ [x : exp u] ((s @ x)↓   ∧ ¬(t @ x)↓)
                                                      ∨ (¬(s @ x)↓) ∧ (t @ x)↓)❙
  
  /T "lambda(s,t:sets[uu], forall(x:uu, not(x in s) or not(x in t)))"❙
  disjointQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# 3 disj 4❘
             = [U,u,s,t] ∀ [x : exp u] ¬(x in s) ∨ ¬(x in t)❙
  
  /T "lambda(w:sets[sets[uu]],s:sets[uu],
     forall(u,v:sets[uu], 
       ((not (u = v)) and (u in w) and (v in w)) implies (u disj v)) and 
     forall(x:uu, (x in s) iff forsome(u:sets[uu], (u in w) and (x in u))))"❙
  partitionQQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[(sets[α])]) ⟶  exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# partition_q 3 4❘
             = [U,uu,w,s] (∀ [u : exp (sets[uu])] ∀ [v : exp (sets[uu])] 
                                     ((¬(u = v) ∧ (u in w) ∧ (v in w)) ⊃ (u disj v)))
                        ∧ (∀ [x : exp uu] (x in s) ⇔ (∃ [y : exp(sets[uu])] (y in w) ∧ (x in y)))❙
                        
  /T "lambda(a:uu, indic(x:uu, x=a))"❙
  singletonQC : {A, α : sort A} exp α ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# singleton 3❘
              = [U,u,a] pred2indic (λ [x : exp u] (x = a))❙
              
  /T "lambda(f:[index,sets[uu]], indic(x:uu, forsome(i:index, #(f(i)(x)))))"❙
  bigUnionQC : {A, I, α : sort A, ζ : sort I} exp (ζ ⇒ (sets[α])) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# big_u 5❘
             = [A,I,a,z,f] pred2indic (λ [x : exp a] ∃ [i : exp z] ((f @ i) @ x)↓)❙
              
  /T "lambda(f:[index,sets[uu]], indic(x:uu, forall(i:index, #(f(i)(x)))))"❙
  bigIntersectionQC : {A, I, α : sort A, ζ : sort I} exp (ζ ⇒ (sets[α])) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# big_i 5❘
                    = [A,I,a,z,f] pred2indic (λ [x : exp a] ∀ [i : exp z] ((f @ i) @ x)↓)❙
                    
                    
  # Found in mappings.t ❙
  
  /T "lambda(f:[ind_2,ind_3],g:[ind_1,ind_2], lambda(x:ind_1, f(g(x))))"❙
  mcompositionQC : {A, B, C, α : sort A, β : sort B, γ : sort C } exp (β ⇒ γ) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ γ)❘# 7 oo 8❘
                 = [A,B,C,a,b,c,f,g] λ [x] (f @ (g @ x))❙
                 
  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2], indic(x:ind_1, #(f(x))))"❙
  mdomainQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# dom 5 ❘
            = [A,B,a,b,f] pred2indic (λ [x : exp a] (f @ x)↓)❙

  /T  "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2], indic(y:ind_2, forsome(x:ind_1, y=f(x))))"❙
  mrangeQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[β])❘# ran 5 ❘
           = [A,B,a,b,f] pred2indic (λ [y : exp b] (∃ [x : exp a] y = f @ x))❙ 
  
  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2],a:sets[ind_1], indic(y:ind_2, forsome(x:ind_1, (x in a) and y=f(x))))"❙
  mimageQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[β])❘# image 5 6❘
           = [A,B,a,b,f,as] pred2indic (λ [y : exp b] (∃ [x : exp a] ((x in as) ∧ (y = (f @ x)))))❙ 

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2],b:sets[ind_2], b oo f)" minverseimageQC ❙
  minverseimageQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp (sets[α])❘# inv_image 5 6❘
                  = [A,B,a,b,f,bs] (bs oo f) ❙ 
  
  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2], lambda(x:ind_2, iota(y:ind_1, f(y)=x)))"❙
  minverseQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (β ⇒ α)❘# inverse 5❘
             = [A,B,a,b,f] λ [x : exp b] (ι [y : exp a] (f @ y) = x)❙ 

  /T "lambda(a:sets[ind_1], lambda(x:ind_1, if(x in a, x, ?ind_1)))"❙
  midQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ α)❘# id 3❘
        = [A,a,as] λ [x : exp a] (if (x in as) then x else (? a))❙ 

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2],a:sets[ind_1], lambda(x:ind_1, if(x in a, f(x), ?ind_2)))"❙
  mrestrictQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ β)❘# restrict 5 6❘
              = [A,B,a,b,f,as] λ [x : exp a] (if (x in as) then (f@x) else (? b))❙ 

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2,ind_3],a:sets[ind_1],b:sets[ind_2],
     lambda(x:ind_1,y:ind_2, if(x in a and y in b, f(x,y), ?ind_3)))"❙
  mrestrict2QC : {A, B, C, α : sort A, β : sort B, γ : sort C} exp (α ⇒ (β ⇒ γ)) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ (β ⇒ γ))❘# restrict2 7 8 9❘
               = [A,B,C,a,b,c,f,as,bs] λ [x] (λ [y] (if ((x in as) ∧ (y in bs)) then (f@x)@y else ? c))❙ 

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2], forall(x:ind_1, x in dom(f)) and forall(y:ind_2, y in ran(f)))"❙
  msurjectiveQQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp bool❘# surjective_q 5❘
                 = [A,B,a,b,f] (∀ [x] (x in (dom f))) ∧ (∀ [y] (y in (ran f)))❙

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2], forall(x_1,x_2:ind_1, f(x_1)=f(x_2) implies x_1=x_2))"❙
  minjectiveQQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp bool❘# injective_q 5❘
                = [A,B,a,b,f] (∀ [x : exp a] (∀ [y : exp a] ((f@x) = (f@y)) ⊃ (x=y)))❙ 

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2], surjective_q(f) and injective_q(f))"❙
  mbijectiveQQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp bool❘# bijective_q 5❘
                = [A,B,a,b,f] ((surjective_q f) ∧ (injective_q f))❙ 

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2],a:sets[ind_1],b:sets[ind_2], dom(f)=a and ran(f)=b)"❙
  msurjectiveonQQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp bool❘# surjective_on_q 5 6 7❘
                   = [A,B,a,b,f,as,bs] (((dom f) = as) ∧ ((ran f) = bs))❙

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2],a:sets[ind_1], forall(x_1,x_2:ind_1, ((x_1 in a) and (x_2 in a) and f(x_1)=f(x_2)) implies x_1=x_2))"❙
  minjectiveonQQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# injective_on_q 5 6❘
                  = [A,B,α,β,f,a] (∀ [x : exp α] (∀ [y : exp α] ((((x in a) ∧ (y in a)) ∧ ((f @ x) = (f @ y))) ⊃ (x = y))))❙

  /T "lambda(f:[ind_1,ind_2],a:sets[ind_1],b:sets[ind_2], surjective_on_q(f,a,b) and injective_on_q(f,a))"❙
  mbijectiveonQQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ β) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp bool❘# bijective_on_q 5 6 7❘
                  = [A,B,a,b,f,as,bs] (surjective_on_q f as bs) ∧ (injective_on_q f as)❙
                  
                  
  # Found in groups.t ❙
  
  /T   "lambda(gg%:sets[gg], mul%:[gg,gg,gg], e%:gg, inv%:[gg,gg], 
     forall(x,y:gg, x in gg% and y in gg% implies mul%(x,y) in gg%) and
     e% in gg% and 
     forall(x:gg, x in gg% implies inv%(x) in gg%) and
     forall(x:gg, x in gg% implies mul%(e%,x)=x) and 
     forall(x:gg, x in gg% implies mul%(x,e%)=x) and
     forall(x:gg, x in gg% implies mul%(inv%(x),x)=e%) and 
     forall(x:gg, x in gg% implies mul%(x,inv%(x))=e%) and
     forall(x,y,z:gg, ((x in gg%) and (y in gg%) and (z in gg%)) implies
       mul%(mul%(x,y),z) = mul%(x,mul%(y,z))))" ❙
  groupsQC : {A, α : sort A} (exp (sets[α])) ⟶ (exp (α ⇒ (α ⇒ α))) ⟶ (exp α) ⟶ (exp (α ⇒ α)) ⟶ (exp bool)❘# group 3 4 5 6❘
           = [A,α,g,m,e,i] ((∀ [x : exp α] ∀ [y : exp α] (((x in g) ∧ (y in g)) ⊃ (((m@x)@y) in g)))
           ∧ (e in g)
           ∧ (∀ [x : exp α] (x in g) ⊃ ((i@x) in g))
           ∧ (∀ [x : exp α] (x in g) ⊃ (((m@e)@x) = x))
           ∧ (∀ [x : exp α] (x in g) ⊃ (((m@x)@e) = x))
           ∧ (∀ [x : exp α] (x in g) ⊃ (((m@(i@x))@x) = e))
           ∧ (∀ [x : exp α] (x in g) ⊃ (((m@x)@(i@x)) = e))
           ∧ (∀ [x : exp α] ∀ [y : exp α] ∀ [z : exp α] ((x in g) ∧ (y in g) ∧ (z in g)) ⊃ (((m@((m@x)@y))@z) = ((m@x)@((m@y)@z)))))❙
           
  # Found in iterate-supplements.t ❙
  
  /T "lambda(s:sets[ind_1], f:[ind_1 -> ind_1], forall(m:ind_1, m in s and #(f(m)) implies f(m) in s))" ❙
  invariantQC : {A, α : sort A} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ α) ⟶ exp bool ❘# invariant 3 4❘
              = [A,α,s,f] (∀ [m : exp α] ((m in s) ∧ ((f@m)↓)) ⊃ ((f@m) in s))❙
              
  # Found in pairs.t❙
  
  /T "lambda(a:ind_1,b:ind_2, lambda(x:ind_1,y:ind_2, if(a=x and b=y, an%individual, ?unit%sort)))" ❙
  pairQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp α ⟶ exp β ⟶ exp (α ⇒ (β ⇒ unitsort))❘# pair 5 6❘
         = [A,B,α,β,a,b] λ [x : exp α] (λ [y : exp β] (if (a = x) ∧ (b = y) then anIndividual else (? unitsort)))❙
  
  /T "lambda(p:sets[ind_1,ind_2], forsome(x:ind_1,y:ind_2, p=pair(x,y)))" ❙
  pairQQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ (β ⇒ unitsort)) ⟶ exp bool❘# pair_q 5❘
          = [A,B,α,β,p] ∃ [x : exp α] (∃ [y : exp β] (p = (pair x y)))❙
  
  /T "lambda(p:sets[ind_1,ind_2], iota(x:ind_1,forsome(y:ind_2, p=pair(x,y))))" ❙
  firstQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ (β ⇒ unitsort)) ⟶ exp α❘# first 5❘
          = [A,B,α,β,p] ι [x : exp α] (∃ [y : exp β] (p = (pair x y)))❙ 
  
  /T "lambda(p:sets[ind_1,ind_2], iota(y:ind_2,forsome(x:ind_1, p=pair(x,y))))" ❙
  secondQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ (β ⇒ unitsort)) ⟶ exp β❘# second 5❘
           = [A,B,α,β,p] ι [y : exp β] (∃ [x : exp α] (p = (pair x y)))❙
  
  /T "lambda(a:sets[ind_1],b:sets[ind_2],indic(p:sets[ind_1,ind_2], pair_q{p} and (first{p} in a) and (second{p} in b)))" -- Defunct?❙
  crossProductQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp (sets[(α ⇒ (β ⇒ unitsort))])❘# crossProduct 5 6❘
                 = [A,B,α,β,a,b] pred2indic (λ [p : exp (α ⇒ (β ⇒ unitsort))] ((pair_q p) ∧ (((first p) in a) ∧ ((second p) in b))))❙
  
  # Found in cardinality.t ❙
  
  /T "lambda(a:sets[ind_1],b:sets[ind_2], forsome(f:[ind_1,ind_2], bijective_on_q(f,a,b)))"❙
  equinumerousQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp bool❘# 5 equinumerous 6❘
                 = [A,B,α,β,a,b] ∃ [f : exp (α ⇒ β)] (bijective_on_q f a b)❙
  
  /T "lambda(a:sets[ind_1],b:sets[ind_2], forsome(f:[ind_1,ind_2], dom(f)=a and (ran(f) subseteq b) and injective_on_q(f,a)))"❙
  embedsQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp bool❘# 5 embeds 6❘
           = [A,B,α,β,a,b] (∃ [f : exp (α ⇒ β)] ((((dom f) = a) ∧ ((ran f) subseteq b)) ∧ (injective_on_q f a)))❙
  
  # Found in finite-cardinality.t ❙
  
  /T "lambda(a:sets[ind_1], iota(n:nn, a equinumerous omega(n)))"❙
  finiteCardinalityQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType, ω : exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ unitsort))} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp ℕ❘# f_card 3 4 5❘
                      = [A,α,ℕ,w,a] ι [n : exp ℕ] (a equinumerous (w@n))❙
  
  /T "lambda(a:sets[ind_1], #(f_card{a}))" ❙
  finiteIndicatorQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType, ω : exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ unitsort))} exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp bool❘# f_indic_q 3 4 5❘
                    = [A,α,ℕ,ω,a] (f_card ℕ ω a) ↓❙
  
  /T "lambda(e:ind_1, f_indic_q{sort_to_indic{ind_1}})" ❙
  finiteSortQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType, ω : exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ unitsort))} exp α ⟶ exp bool❘# f_sort_q 3 4 5❘
               = [A,α,ℕ,ω,e] f_indic_q ℕ ω (sort2indic α e)❙
  
  # Found in sequences.t ❙
  
  /T "lambda(s:[nn,ind_1],iota(n:nn,forall(m:nn, m<n iff #(s(m)))))" ❙
  lengthQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType, leq : exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ bool))} exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp ℕ❘# length 3 4 5❘
           = [A,α,ℕ,leq,s] ι [n : exp ℕ] (∀ [m : exp ℕ] (((leq@m)@n) ⇔ ((s@m)↓)))❙
  
  /T "lambda(s:[nn,ind_1], #(length(s)))" ❙
  fSeqQQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType, leq : exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ bool))} exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp bool❘# f_seq_q 3 4 5❘
          = [A,α,ℕ,leq,s] (length ℕ leq s)↓❙
  
  /T "lambda(e:ind_1, lambda(n:nn, ?ind_1))"❙
  nilQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType} exp α ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α)❘# nil 3 4❘
        = [A,α,ℕ,e] λ [n : exp ℕ] (? α)❙
  
  /T "lambda(e:ind_1, s:[nn,ind_1],  lambda(n:nn, if(n<1, e, s(n-1))))"❙
  consQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType} exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ bool)) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ ℕ)) ⟶ exp ℕ ⟶ exp α ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α)❘# cons 3 4 5 6 7 8❘
         = [A,α,ℕ,leq,minus,one,e,s] λ [n : exp ℕ] (if (leq@n)@one then e else s@((minus@n)@one))❙
  
  /T "lambda(s:[nn,ind_1], n:ind, lambda(m:nn, if(#(n,nn), s(n+m), ?ind_1)))"❙
  dropQC : {A, α : sort A, ν : sort indType, ℕ : sort indType} exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ ℕ)) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp ν ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α)❘# drop 4 5 6 7❘
         = [A,α,ν,ℕ,plus,s,n] λ [m : exp ℕ] (if (n ↓ ℕ) then s@((plus@n)@m) else ? α)❙
  
  /T "lambda(s:[nn,ind_1], n:ind,lambda(m:nn, if(m<n, s(m), ?ind_1)))"❙
  takeFirstQC : {A, α : sort A, ν : sort indType, ℕ : sort indType} exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ bool)) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp ν ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α)❘# takeFirst 4 5 6 7❘
              = [A,α,ν,ℕ,leq,s,n] λ [m : exp ℕ] (if ((leq@m)@n) then (s@m) else ? α)❙
  
  /T "lambda(s_1,s_2:[nn,ind_1],lambda(m:nn, if(length(s_1)<=m, s_2(m-length(s_1)), s_1(m))))" ❙
  appendQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType} exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ bool)) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ ℕ)) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α)❘# append 3 4 5 6 7❘
           = [A,α,ℕ,leq,minus,s1,s2] λ [m : exp ℕ] (if ((leq@(length ℕ leq s1))@m) then (s2@((minus@(m))@(length ℕ leq s1))) else (s1@m))❙
  
  /T "lambda(x:ind_1, s_1:[nn,ind_1],forsome(i:nn, s_1(i)=x))"❙
  inSeqQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType} exp α ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp bool❘# inSeq 3 4 5❘
          = [A,α,ℕ,x,s] ∃ [i : exp ℕ] ((s@i) = x)❙
  
  # Found in sequences-supplements.t ❙
  
  /T "lambda(f:[nn,ind_1], lambda(n:nn, f (omega%embedding(dom{f})(n))))" ❙
  collapseQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType} exp ((sets[ℕ]) ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ ℕ)) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α)❘# collapse 3 4 5❘
             = [A,α,ℕ,ω,f] λ [n : exp ℕ] (f@((ω@(dom f))@n))❙
  
  /T "lambda(f:[nn,ind_1],a:sets[ind_1],collapse(lambda(n:nn, if(f(n) in a, f(n), ?ind_1))))" ❙
  constrictQC : {A, α : sort A, ℕ : sort indType} exp ((sets[ℕ]) ⇒ (ℕ ⇒ ℕ)) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α) ⟶ exp (sets[α]) ⟶ exp (ℕ ⇒ α)❘# constrict 3 4 5 6❘
              = [A,α,ℕ,ω,f,a] collapse ℕ ω (λ [n : exp ℕ] (if ((f@n) in a) then f@n else (? α)))❙
  
  # Found in covers.t ❙
  
  /T "lambda(v:[zz,sets[ind_1]],a:sets[ind_1],forall(x:ind_1,x in a implies forsome(n:zz,x in v(n))))" ❙
  countableCoverQC : { A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ (sets[β])) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp bool❘# countable%cover 5 6❘
                   = [A,B,z,b,v,a] ∀ [x : exp b] ((x in a) ⊃ (∃ [n : exp z] (x in (v@n))))❙ 
  
  /T "lambda(v:[zz,sets[ind_1]],a:sets[ind_1],forsome(m:zz,forall(x:ind_1,x in a implies forsome(n:zz,-m<=n and n<=m and x in v(n)))))" ❙
  finiteCoverQC : {A, B, α : sort A, β : sort B} exp (α ⇒ α) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ (α ⇒ bool)) ⟶ exp (α ⇒ (sets[β])) ⟶ exp (sets[β]) ⟶ exp bool❘# finite%cover 7 8❘
                = [A,B,z,i,minus,leq,v,a] ∃ [m : exp z] (∀ [x : exp i] ((x in a) ⊃ (∃ [n : exp z] (((leq@(minus@m))@n) ∧ ((leq@n)@m) ∧ (x in (v@n))))))❙

namespace latin:/ ❚
import lfx http://gl.mathhub.info/MMT/LFX/TypedHierarchy ❚

theory Mizar : ur:?LFS =
  include ?SoftTypedDefinedFOL ❙
	
	// terms (a meta-type for all objects)❙
  // term : type 
	// set in Mizar ❙
	// FOL relative to term ❙
	// prop : type ❙
  // true : prop ❙
  // false : prop ❙
  // not : prop ⟶ prop ❘ # not 1 prec 20 ❘ ## ¬ 1 prec 20❙
	// and: prop ⟶ prop ⟶ prop ❘# 1 and 2 ❙
	nary_and : {n} prop^n ⟶ prop❘
       # 2and… prec 10❘## 2&… prec 10❙
  0ary_and_prop: ⊦ nary_and 0 ⟨⟩ ❙
  1ary_and_prop: {p: prop} ⊦ nary_and 1 ⟨p⟩ ⇔ p ❙
  and_induct_prop: {n: NAT, ps: prop^n, p: prop} ⊦ nary_and (succ n) ⟨p, ps⟩ ⇔ p ∧ nary_and n ps ❙
   &   : {n} prop^n ⟶ prop ❘= [n,x] nary_and n x❘
       # 2&… prec 10❙
	// or: prop ⟶ prop ⟶ prop ❘= [a,b] not (not a and not b) ❘# 1 or 2 ❙
	nary_or  : {n} prop^n ⟶ prop ❘= [n][x] not (nary_and n ⟨' (not (x..i)) | i:n '⟩) ❘
       # 2or… prec 10❘## 2∨… prec 10❙ 
	// implies: prop ⟶ prop ⟶ prop ❘ = [a,b] ¬ (a ∧ (¬ b)) ❘ # 1 ⇒ 2 prec 15 ❘## 1 implies 2 prec 15 ❙
	// implies_def: {a,b} ⊦ ¬ (a ∧ (¬ b)) ⟶ ⊦ a ⇒ b ❙
	// implies_def_conv: {a,b} ⊦ a ⇒ b ⟶ ⊦ ¬ (a ∧ (¬ b)) ❙

	// iff: prop ⟶ prop ⟶ prop ❘ = [a,b] (a ⇒ b) ∧ (b ⇒ a) ❘ # 1 iff 2 prec 15 ❙
	// equiv_def: {a,b} ⊦ (a ⇒ b) ∧ (b ⇒ a) ⟶ ⊦ a ⇔ b ❙
	// equiv_def_conv: {a,b} ⊦ a ⇔ b ⟶ ⊦ (a ⇒ b) ∧ (b ⇒ a) ❙

	// equal: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop ❘# 1 ≐ 2 prec 25 ❘ ## 1 = 2 prec 25 ❙
	inequal: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop ❘ = [a, b] ¬ (a ≐ b) ❙
	// forall: (term ⟶ prop) ⟶ prop ❘ # ∀ 1 ❙
	// exists: (term ⟶ prop) ⟶ prop ❘ = [pred] ¬ (∀ ([x:term] (¬ (pred x)))) ❘# ∃ 1 ❙
	// existsUnique: (term ⟶ prop) ⟶ prop ❘ = [pred] (∃ pred) ∧ (∀ [x:term] ∀ [y:term] (pred x ⇒ pred y ⇒ (x ≐ y))) ❙

	// types ❙
	// tp: type 
	// MODE in Mizar ❙
	// of : term ⟶ tp ⟶ prop ❘ # 1 ∶ 2 prec 50
  // is in Mizar ❙
	makeMode : (term ⟶ prop) ⟶ tp ❙
	binaryintersectionMode: tp ⟶ tp ⟶ tp ❘ = [a,b] makeMode ([x] x ∶ a ∧ x ∶ b) ❙
	intersectionMode: {n:NAT, tps: tp^n} tp ❘ = [n, tps] makeMode ([x] (nary_and n ⟨' x ∶ (tps .. i) | i:n '⟩)) ❙
 
	// quantification over types ❙
	// for: {A:tp, p: term ⟶ prop} prop ❘ = [A, p] ∀ [x] x ∶ A ⇒ p x ❙
	// ex: {A:tp, p: term ⟶ prop} prop ❘ = [A, p] ∃ [x] (x ∶ A) ∧ (p x) ❙

	// proofs ❙
	// ded: prop ⟶ type ❘ # ⊦ 1 prec -5❘ ## ded 1 prec -5 ❙
	/T Fold the ps over TacticsLF?use to give a definien for this ? ❙
	using: {n, ps: type^n, claim: prop} ⊦ claim ❘ # 3 using 2 ❙
	/T infereable but not inferred term of type tp ❙
	dummyTerm : {t: tp} term ❘ # dummy ❙
  be: term ⟶ tp ⟶ type ❘= [x,a] ⊦ x ∶ a ❘# 1 be 2 prec 50❙

  // propositional logic❙
  contradiction : type ❘= ⊦ false ❙
	not_contradition : prop ❘= true ❙
	// inconsistent (from ☞base:?Proofs) is formalized as {a} ⊦ a, so we can't use it. ❙
  /T what is currently still left to show in a proof ❙
	thesis: type ❙
      
  // attributes as predicates on types❙
  attr : tp ⟶ type ❘= [t] (term ⟶ prop)❙
  dep_typed_attr : {n:NAT, t:term^n ⟶ tp} type ❘= [n, t] (term ⟶ prop) ❙
     
   // choice operator ❙
  choice : tp ⟶ term❙
  choice_prop : {t : tp} ⊦ (choice t) ∶  t ❙
    
  // types formed by imposing a possibly negated attribute on a type❙
  adjective : {t: tp} attr t ⟶ tp ❘ # 2 _ 1 ❙
  dep_typed_adjective : {n:NAT, t: term^n ⟶ tp} dep_typed_attr n t ⟶ tp ❘ # adj_appl 3 2 ❙
	attr_appl: {n:NAT, m:NAT, t: term^n ⟶ tp, attrs: (dep_typed_attr n t)^m} tp ❘= [n,m,t,attrs] intersectionMode m (⟨' (dep_typed_adjective n t (attrs .. i)) | i:m '⟩) ❘ # 4 @ 3 ❙

  // adjective_prop : ⊦ X of (adjective T A) ⇔ X of T ∧ A X❙
  adjI : {X,A}{x : term} x be X ⟶ (⊦ A x) ⟶ x be (adjective X A)❙
  adjE : {X,A}{x : term} x be (adjective X A) ⟶  x be X❙
  adjE_' : {X,A}{x : term} x be (adjective X A) ⟶ ⊦ A x❙

  fraenkelTerm : {univ:tp, n, expr: term^n ⟶ term, cond: term^n ⟶ prop} term ❙
  simpleFraenkelTerm : {univ:tp, n, expr: term^n ⟶ term} term ❘= [u,n,expr] fraenkelTerm u n expr ([tms:term^n] not_contradition) ❙
  proof_by_example : {A: tp, tm: term} tm be A ❙
   
  // rule mmt/lf?Realize term mmt/api/uom?StandardInt❙

	// typed vs. untyped quantification ❙
	univ_restriction_prop: {A: tp, p:term ⟶ prop} ⊦ (∀ [x] p x ⇒ for A [x] p x) ❙
	exist_restriction_prop: {A: tp, p:term ⟶ prop} ⊦ (ex A [x] p x ⇒ ∃ [x] p x) ❙
	univ_restriction_suffices: {A: tp, p:term ⟶ prop} ⊦ ∀ ([x] (¬ (x ∶ A) ⇒ ¬ (p x))) ⟶ ⊦ ((∀ ([x] p x)) ⇔ (for A [x] p x))❙
	exist_restriction_suffices: {A: tp, p:term ⟶ prop} ⊦ ∀ ([x] (¬ (x ∶ A) ⇒ ¬ (p x))) ⟶ ⊦ ((∃ ([x] p x)) ⇔ (ex A [x] p x))❙
❚


theory HIDDEN : ?SoftTypedDefinedFOL = 
	// realize ?Mizar ❙
   include ?Mizar ❙
   
	 // sets (submode of object)❙
   set : tp ❙
   set_ax : {X:term} ⊦ X ∶ set ❙
	 sethoot_property: {t:tp} prop ❘ = [t] for t [tm] (tm ∶ t ⇒ tm ∶ set) ❙
	 commutativity_property: {f: term ⟶ term ⟶ term} prop ❘ = [f] ∀ [x] ∀ [y] (f x y ≐ f y x) ❙
	 idempotence_property: {f: term ⟶ term ⟶ term} prop ❘ = [f] ∀ [x] (f x x ≐ x) ❙
	 projectivity_property: {f: term ⟶ term} prop ❘ = [f] ∀ [x] (f ( f x) ≐ f x) ❙
	 involutiveness_property: {f: term ⟶ term} prop ❘ = [f] ∀ [x] f ( f x) ≐ x ❙
	 
	 symmetry_property: {R: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop} prop ❘ = [R] ∀ [x] ∀ [y] (R x y ⇒ R y x) ❙
	 assymmetry_property: {R: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop} prop ❘ = [R] ∀ [x] ∀ [y] (R x y ⇒ ¬ R y x) ❙
	 connectedness_property: {R: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop} prop ❘ = [R] ∀ [x] ∀ [y] (R x y ∨ R y x) ❙
	 reflexivity_property: {R: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop} prop ❘ = [R] ∀ [x] R x x ❙
	 irreflexivity_property: {R: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop} prop ❘ = [R] ∀ [x] ¬ R x x ❙

   // set: type ❙

   // eq is already declared in Mizar
   // eq : any ⟶ any ⟶ prop❘= [x][y] x eq y❘# 1 = 2 prec 25❙
   inequal : term ⟶ term ⟶ prop❘= [x][y] not (x ≐ y)❘ # 1 <> 2 prec 25❘## 1 ≠ 2 prec 25❙
   // include ?InternalTypes ❙
   // be object -> be term -> prop❙
		
   in : term ⟶ term ⟶ prop ❘ # 1 in 2 prec 35❘ ## 1 ‍∈ 2 prec 35❙

   function: tp❙
   ordinal: tp❙
   dom: term ⟶ term❙
   funcAppl: term ⟶ term ⟶ term❙
   id: term ⟶ prop❙
   /T the example is from finset_1: The application of id is necessary, since the typechecker would otherwise complain (even more) 
   originally x had idnr 20 and f idnr 22 ❙
   /T scheme1: {x:term^4} ⟨' ⊦ (x..i) ∶ (⟨([x:term^4] set),([x:term^4] term⟶prop),([x:term^4] term⟶term),([x:term^4] term⟶term)⟩..i) x | i:4 '⟩ ⟶ 
     ⊦ nary_and 0 ⟨⟩ ⟶ ⊦ (([x:term^4] (ex function [f:term] nary_and 2 ⟨((dom f) ≐ (x..0)),(for ordinal [y: term] (y in (x..0)) 
     ⇒ (nary_and 2 ⟨id (x..1) ⇒ ((funcAppl f y) ≐ (x..2)), (implies (¬(id (x..1))) ((funcAppl f y) ≐ (x..3)))⟩))⟩)) x) ❙
	// exam: {A: tp, B: tp, p: attr A, q: attr B, r: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop, s: term ⟶ term ⟶ prop} prop ❘// = [A, B, p, q, r, s] for A [x] (x ∶ A) ∧ (ex A [z] ( (r x z) ∧ (for B [y] (((s x y) ∧ (r x y)) ⇒ ( (r x y) ∧ (r x z) ))))) ❙

namespace latin:/ ❚

import rules scala://mmtwrapper.mizar.mmt.kwarc.info ❚

theory MizarPatterns : ?HIDDEN =
	/T axiomatization of the claims of various correctness conditions
     named roughly in the format <correctnessCondition><Pattern>, where <correctnessCondition> is the correctness condition and <Pattern> the pattern used in the definition or registration ❙
	consistencyDirectFuncDef: {n:NAT, argTps:(term^n ⟶ tp)^n, m:NAT, cases:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m, caseRes:(term^n ⟶ term)^m} type ❘ = [n, argTps, m, cases, caseRes] {x:term^n, p: ⟨' ⊦ x..i ∶ (argTps..i) x | i:n '⟩} ⊦ 
						nary_and m ⟨' (cases..j) x ⇒ nary_and m ⟨' (cases..k) x ⇒ (caseRes..j) x ≐ (caseRes..k) x | k:m '⟩ | j:m '⟩ ❙
	consistencyIndirectFuncDef: {n:NAT, argTps:(term^n ⟶ tp)^n, m:NAT, cases:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m, caseRes:(term^(succ n) ⟶ prop)^m} type ❘ = [n, argTps, m, cases, caseRes] {x:term^n, p: ⟨' ⊦ x..i ∶ (argTps..i) x | i:n '⟩} ⊦ 
						nary_and m ⟨' (cases..j) x ⇒ nary_and m ⟨' (cases..k) x ⇒ forall [y] (caseRes..j) ⟨ x, y ⟩ ⇔ (caseRes..k) ⟨ x, y ⟩ | k:m '⟩ | j:m '⟩ ❙
	consistencyDirectPredAttrDef: {n:NAT, argTps:(term^n ⟶ tp)^n, m:NAT, cases:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m, caseRes:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m} type ❘ = [n, argTps, m, cases, caseRes] {x:term^n, p: ⟨' ⊦ x..i ∶ (argTps..i) x | i:n '⟩} ⊦ 
						nary_and m ⟨' (cases..j) x ⇒ nary_and m ⟨' (cases..k) x ⇒ (caseRes..j) x ⇔ (caseRes..k) x | k:m '⟩ | j:m '⟩ ❙
	consistencyIndirectPredAttrDef: {n:NAT, argTps:(term^n ⟶ tp)^n, m:NAT, cases:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m, caseRes:(term^(succ n) ⟶ prop)^m} type ❘ = [n, argTps, m, cases, caseRes] {x:term^n, p: ⟨' ⊦ x..i ∶ (argTps..i) x | i:n '⟩} ⊦ 
						nary_and m ⟨' (cases..j) x ⇒ nary_and m ⟨' (cases..k) x ⇒ forall [y] (caseRes..j) ⟨ x, y ⟩ ⇔ (caseRes..k) ⟨ x, y ⟩ | k:m '⟩ | j:m '⟩ ❙
	consistencyDirectModeDef: {n:NAT, argTps:(term^n ⟶ tp)^n, m:NAT, cases:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m, caseRes:(term^n ⟶ term ⟶ prop)^m} type ❘ = [n, argTps, m, cases, caseRes] {x:term^n, p: ⟨' ⊦ x..i ∶ (argTps..i) x | i:n '⟩} ⊦ 
						nary_and m ⟨' (cases..j) x ⇒ nary_and m ⟨' (cases..k) x ⇒ forall [s] (caseRes..j) x s ⇔ (caseRes..k) x s | k:m '⟩ | j:m '⟩ ❙
	consistencyIndirectModeDef: {n:NAT, argTps:(term^n ⟶ tp)^n, m:NAT, cases:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m, caseRes:(term^n ⟶ (term ⟶ prop) ⟶ prop)^m} type ❘ = [n, argTps, m, cases, caseRes] {x:term^n, p: ⟨' ⊦ x..i ∶ (argTps..i) x | i:n '⟩} ⊦ 
						nary_and m ⟨' (cases..j) x ⇒ nary_and m ⟨' (cases..k) x ⇒ for set [modeElems] (caseRes..j) x ([arg:term] arg in modeElems) ⇔ (caseRes..k) x ([y:term] y in modeElems) | k:m '⟩ | j:m '⟩ ❙
	


	existenceDirectComplModeDef: {n:NAT, argTps:(term^n ⟶ tp)^n, m:NAT, cases:(term^n ⟶ prop)^m, caseRes:(term^n ⟶ term ⟶ prop)^m} type ❘ = [n, argTps, m, cases, caseRes] {x:term^n, p: ⟨' ⊦ x..i ∶ (argTps..i) x | i:n '⟩} ⊦ 
						nary_and m ⟨' (cases..j) x ⇒ ∃ [y] (caseRes..j) x y | j:m '⟩ ❙

module meta_monoids {
    theory UnitElement {
        include .magmas.Magma
        e : univ
        realize .magmas.Pointed
        point = e
        involution : univ -> bool = x -> (x∘x == e)
    }

    theory RightUnital {
        include UnitElement
        neutralR:--- x∘e == x
    }

    theory LeftUnital {
        include UnitElement
        neutralL:--- e∘x == x
    }

    theory Unital {
        include LeftUnital
        include RightUnital
    }

    theory FirstNonNeutral {
        include Unital
        FirstNonNeutral:--- x != e => forall y. x∘y == x
    }

    theory LastNonNeutral {
        include Unital
        LastNonNeutral:--- y != e => forall x. x∘y == y
    }

    theory Powers {
        include .magmas.PowerAssociative
        include Unital
        include .Numbers.Nat
        power: (univ, num) -> univ
        power_zero:--- power(x, .Numbers.Nat.z) == e
        power_succ:--- power(x, .Numbers.Nat.s(n)) == power(x, n) ∘ x
    }

    theory Monoid {
        include .magmas.Semigroup
        include Unital
        inverse: (univ, univ) -> bool = (x, y) -> (x∘y == e) & (y∘x == e)
        inverse_sym:--- inverse(x, y) => inverse(y, x)
        inverse_unique:--- inverse(x, y1) & inverse(x, y2) => (y1 == y2)
        inverse_neutral:--- inverse(e, e)
        inverse_op:--- inverse(x1, x2) & inverse(y1, y2) => inverse(x1∘y1, x2∘y2) 
        involution_inverse:--- (involution(x) => inverse(x, x)) & (inverse(x, x) => involution(x))
    }

    theory Involutory {
        include Monoid
        involutory:--- involution(x)
        inverse_refl:--- inverse(x,x)
        inverse_ident:--- inverse(x,y) => (x == y)
    }

    theory IdempotentMonoid {
        include Monoid
        include .magmas.Band
    }

    theory CommMonoid {
        include Monoid
        include .magmas.CommSemigroup
    }

    theory BoundedSemilattice {
        include .magmas.Semilattice
        include CommMonoid
    }
}

module meta_groups {
    theory Quasigroup {
        include .magmas.Magma
        div_left:--- exists a. a∘x == y
        div_right:--- exists b. b∘x == y
    }

    theory Loop {
        include Quasigroup
        include .monoids.Monoid
    }

    theory InverseOperator {
        include .magmas.Semigroup
        inv: univ -> univ # postfix ⁻
        is_weak_inverse: (univ, univ) -> bool = (x, y) -> (x∘(y∘x) == x) & (y∘(x∘y) == y)
    }

    theory WeakInverse {
        include InverseOperator
        weak_inverse:--- is_weak_inverse(x, x⁻)
    }

    theory InverseFun {
        include .monoids.Monoid
        include InverseOperator
        inverseLeft:--- (x⁻)∘x == e
        inverseRight:--- x∘(x⁻) == e
        div: (univ, univ) -> univ = (x, y) -> x∘(y⁻)
        inverse_inv:--- inverse(x, x⁻)
        inv_unit: |- e⁻ == e
        inv_inv:--- (x⁻)⁻ == x
        inv_op:--- (x∘y)⁻ == (y⁻)∘(x⁻)

        include MeetSemilattice

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory TypeBase =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // Class P is the class of all sets satisfying P❙
  Class : (set ⟶ prop) ⟶ type❙
  celem : {P,x} ⊦ P x ⟶ Class P❘ # %n 2 3❙
  cwhich : {P} Class P ⟶ set❘ # %n 2 prec 50❙
  cwhy : {P,c:Class P} ⊦ P (cwhich c)❘# %n 2 prec 50❙

  Eq : {P} Class P ⟶ Class P ⟶ prop❘# 2 Eq 3❘
    = [P,c,d] cwhich c =ͧ cwhich d❙

  // rules for Classes❙
  // a term with a proof is equal to the original term❙
  ceq_which : {P,x,p} ⊦ (cwhich (celem P x p)) =ͧ x❘role Simplify❙
  // Elements of classes are equal if their first components are (proof irrelevance)❙
  EqcongEl : {P,c,d,F: Class P ⟶ prop} ⊦ c Eq d ⟶ ⊦ F c ⟶ ⊦ F d❘# 5 EqcongEl 4 6❙
  
  EqcongEr : {P,c,d,F: Class P ⟶ prop} ⊦ c Eq d ⟶ ⊦ F d ⟶ ⊦ F c❘# 5 EqcongEr 4 6❘
    = [P,c,d,F,p,q] (eq/sym p) EqcongEl F q❙
  EqcongS : {P,c,d,F: Class P ⟶ set} ⊦ c Eq d ⟶ ⊦ (F c) =ͧ (F d)❘
    = [P,c,d,F,p] p EqcongEl ([u] F c =ͧ F u) eq/refl❙
  EqCongC : {P,Q,c,d,F: Class P ⟶ Class Q} ⊦ c Eq d ⟶ ⊦ (cwhich (F c) =ͧ cwhich (F d))❘
    = [P,Q,c,d,F,p] p EqcongEl ([u] cwhich F c =ͧ cwhich F u) eq/refl❙
  EqRefl : {P,c: Class P} ⊦ c Eq c❘ = [P,e] eq/refl❙

  Class_repr : {P,c:Class P} ⊦ c Eq celem (cwhich c) (cwhy c)❘
    = [P,c] eq/refl❙
  Class_irrel : {P,x,p,q: ⊦ P x} ⊦ celem x p Eq celem x q❘
    = [P,x,p,q] eq/refl❘# %n %I4❙
  

  // specialization for the classes of elements of a set A❙
  Elem : set ⟶ type❘ = [A] Class [x] x∈A❙
  elem : {A,x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ Elem A❘
    = [A,x,p] celem ([u] u∈A) x p❘# elem 2 3❙
  which : {A} Elem A ⟶ set❘
    = [A,e] cwhich e❘# which 2 prec 50❙
  why : {A,e:Elem A} ⊦ which e ∈ A❘
    = [A,e] cwhy e❘# why 2❙
  eq_which : {A,x,p: ⊦ x∈A} ⊦ which (elem x p) =ͧ x❘
    = [A,x,p] eq/refl❘ role Simplify❙
  
  // some proofs are missing here❙  
  EqcongB : {A,B,F: Elem A ⟶ Elem B,G: Elem A ⟶ Elem B} ({e} ⊦ (F e) Eq (G e)) ⟶ {P: (Elem A ⟶ Elem B) ⟶ prop} ⊦ P F ⟶ ⊦ P G❙
  
  // trying to solve the simplify problem❙
  simpP : {A,e: Elem A, P: Elem A ⟶ prop} ⊦ P e ⇔ P (elem (which e) (why e))❘# simpP 3❙
  simpF : {A,e: Elem A, F: Elem A ⟶ set} ⊦ F e =ͧ F (elem (which e) (why e))❘# simpF 3❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory SetDefinitions =
  set = term❙
  
  in : set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘# 1 ∈ 2 prec 30❙
  
  eq_in : {x,y,A} ⊦ x =ͧ y ⟶ ⊦ y∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈A❘
    = [x,y,A,p,q] (eq/sym p) ucongP ([u] u∈A) q❙
  in_eq : {x,A,B} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ A =ͧ B ⟶ ⊦ x∈B❘
    = [x,A,B,p,q] q ucongP ([U] x∈U) p❙
❚

theory ExtensionalityAx =
  include ?SetDefinitions❙

  // Two sets A and B are equal iff they have the same elements❙
  isextensional = [A,B] (∀ͧ[x] (x∈A ⇔ x∈B)) ⇔ A =ͧ B❙

  extensionality_axiom : {A,B} ⊦ isextensional A B❙	
  extensionalityI : {A,B} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⇔ x∈B) ⟶ ⊦ A =ͧ B❘
    = [A,B,Q] extensionality_axiom equivEl (uforallI Q)❙
  extensionalityE : {A,B} ⊦ A =ͧ B ⟶ {x} ⊦ x∈A ⇔ x∈B❘# 3 extensionalityE❘
    = [A,B,p,x] extensionality_axiom equivEr p uforallE x❙
❚

theory SubsetDefinitions =
  include ?SetDefinitions❙
  
  subset : set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘# 1 ⊆ 2 prec 30❘
    = [A,B] ∀ͧ[x] x∈A ⇒ x∈B❙
  subsetI : {A,B} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈B) ⟶ ⊦ A⊆B❘
    = [A,B,Q] uforallI ([x] implI ([p] Q x p))❙
  subsetE : {A,B} ⊦ A⊆B ⟶ {x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈B❘# 5 subsetE 3❘
    = [A,B,p,x,q] p uforallE x implE q❙
    
  subset_refl : {A} ⊦ A⊆A❘
    = [A] subsetI ([x,p] p)❙
  subset_trans : {A,B,C} ⊦ A⊆B ⟶ ⊦ B⊆C ⟶ ⊦ A⊆C❘
    = [A,B,C,p,q] subsetI ([x,pa] (pa subsetE p) subsetE q)❙
❚

// This could be written in SubsetDefinitions, but then subset would be dependent
  on ExtensionalityAx. Because both theories are part of SetBase, this would be irrelevant.❚
theory SubsetExtensionality =
  include ?SubsetDefinitions❙
  include ?ExtensionalityAx❙
  
  subset_eq : {A,B} ⊦ A⊆B ⟶ ⊦ B⊆A ⟶ ⊦ A =ͧ B❘
    = [A,B,pa,pb] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([qa] qa subsetE pa) ([qb] qb subsetE pb))❙
❚

theory EmptyDefinitions =
  include ?SetDefinitions❙

  isempty : set ⟶ prop❘ = [A] ¬∃ͧ[x]x∈A❙
  nonempty : set ⟶ prop❘ = [A] ∃ͧ[x]x∈A❙
  
  isemptyE : {A,x} ⊦ isempty A ⟶ ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ↯❘ # 3 isemptyE 4❘
    = [A,x,p,q] p notE (uexistsI x q)❙
  nonemptyE : {A,C} ⊦ nonempty A ⟶ ({x} ⊦x∈A ⟶ ⊦C) ⟶ ⊦C❘
    = [A,C,ne,P] ne uexistsE [x,p] P x p❙
  
  all_nonempty : set ⟶ prop❘
    = [A] ∀ͧ[X] X∈A ⇒ nonempty X❙
  all_nonemptyI : {A} ({X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ nonempty X) ⟶ ⊦ all_nonempty A❘
    = [A,Q] uforallI ([X] implI ([p] Q X p))❙
  all_nonemptyE : {A} ⊦ all_nonempty A ⟶ {X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ nonempty X❘
    = [A,p,X,q] p uforallE X implE q❙
❚

theory DisjointDefinitions =
  include ?SetDefinitions❙
  
  // AS: maybe rewrite this as ¬(∃ͧ[x] x∈A ∧ x∈B), but this would be a bit more annoying to proof❙
  aredisjoint : set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘
    = [A,B] ∀ͧ[x] ¬(x∈A ∧ x∈B)❙
  aredisjointI : {A,B} ({x} ⊦ ¬ (x∈A ∧ x∈B)) ⟶ ⊦ aredisjoint A B❘
    = [A,B,Q] uforallI Q❙
  aredisjointE : {A,B} ⊦ aredisjoint A B ⟶ {x} ⊦ ¬(x∈A ∧ x∈B)❘
    = [A,B,p,x] p uforallE x❙
  
  ispwdisjoint : set ⟶ prop❘
    = [A] ∀ͧ[x]∀ͧ[y] x∈A ∧ y∈A ⇒ x =ͧ y ∨ aredisjoint x y❙
  ispwdisjointI : {A} ({x,y} ⊦ x∈A ∧ y∈A ⟶ ⊦ x =ͧ y ∨ aredisjoint x y) ⟶ ⊦ ispwdisjoint A❘
    = [A,Q] uforallI ([x] uforallI ([y] implI ([p] Q x y p)))❙
  ispwdisjointE : {A} ⊦ ispwdisjoint A ⟶ {x,y} ⊦ x∈A ∧ y∈A ⟶ ⊦ x =ͧ y ∨ aredisjoint x y❘
    = [A,p,x,y,q] p uforallE x uforallE y implE q❙
❚

theory RelationDefinitions =
  include ?SetDefinitions❙
  
  islefttotal : (set ⟶ set ⟶ prop) ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘
    = [f,A] ∀ͧ[x] x∈A ⇒ ∃ͧ[y] f x y❙
  islefttotalI : {f,A} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ ∃ͧ[y] f x y) ⟶ ⊦ islefttotal f A❘
    = [f,A,Q] uforallI ([x] implI ([p] Q x p))❙
  islefttotalE : {f,A} ⊦ islefttotal f A ⟶ {x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ ∃ͧ[y] f x y❘# 3 islefttotalE 4 5❘
    = [f,A,p,x,q] p uforallE x implE q❙
  
  isrighttotal : (set ⟶ set ⟶ prop) ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘
    = [f,B] ∀ͧ[y] y∈B ⇒ ∃ͧ[x] f x y❙
  isrighttotalI : {f,B} ({y} ⊦ y∈B ⟶ ⊦ ∃ͧ[x] f x y) ⟶ ⊦ isrighttotal f B❘
    = [f,B,Q] uforallI ([y] implI ([p] Q y p))❙
  isrighttotalE : {f,B} ⊦ isrighttotal f B ⟶ {y} ⊦ y∈B ⟶ ⊦ ∃ͧ[x] f x y❘# 3 isrighttotalE 4 5❘
    = [f,B,p,y,q] p uforallE y implE q❙  
  
  isleftunique : (set ⟶ set ⟶ prop) ⟶ prop❘
    = [f] ∀ͧ[x]∀ͧ[y]∀ͧ[z] (f x y ∧ f z y) ⇒ x =ͧ z❙
  isleftuniqueI : {f} ({x,y,z} ⊦ f x y ∧ f z y ⟶ ⊦ x =ͧ z) ⟶ ⊦ isleftunique f❘
    = [f,Q] uforallI ([x] uforallI ([y] uforallI ([z] implI ([p] Q x y z p))))❙
  isleftuniqueE : {f} ⊦ isleftunique f ⟶ {x,y,z} ⊦ f x y ∧ f z y ⟶ ⊦ x =ͧ z❘# 2 isleftuniqueE 3 4 5 6❘
    = [f,p,x,y,z,q] p uforallE x uforallE y uforallE z implE q❙
    
  isrightunique : (set ⟶ set ⟶ prop) ⟶ prop❘
    = [f] ∀ͧ[x]∀ͧ[y]∀ͧ[z] (f x y ∧ f x z) ⇒ y =ͧ z❙
  isrightuniqueI : {f} ({x,y,z} ⊦ f x y ∧ f x z ⟶ ⊦ y =ͧ z) ⟶ ⊦ isrightunique f❘
    = [f,Q] uforallI ([x] uforallI ([y] uforallI ([z] implI ([p] Q x y z p))))❙
  isrightuniqueE : {f} ⊦ isrightunique f ⟶ {x,y,z} ⊦ f x y ∧ f x z ⟶ ⊦ y =ͧ z❘# 2 isrightuniqueE 3 4 5 6❘
    = [f,p,x,y,z,q] p uforallE x uforallE y uforallE z implE q❙
    
  // a function is lefttotal and rightunique❙
  isfunction : (set ⟶ set ⟶ prop) ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘
    = [f,A] islefttotal f A ∧ isrightunique f❙
  isfunctionI : {f,A} ⊦ islefttotal f A ⟶ ⊦ isrightunique f ⟶ ⊦ isfunction f A❘
    = [f,A,pl,pr] andI pl pr❙
  isfunctionEl : {f,A} ⊦ isfunction f A ⟶ ⊦ islefttotal f A❘
    = [f,A,p] p andEl❙
  isfunctionEr : {f,A} ⊦ isfunction f A ⟶ ⊦ isrightunique f❘
    = [f,A,p] p andEr❙
  
  fun2rel : (set ⟶ set) ⟶ (set ⟶ set ⟶ prop)❘
    = [f] [x,y] f x =ͧ y❙
  isfun_fun2rel : {f,A} ⊦ isfunction (fun2rel f) A❘
    = [f,A] andI (islefttotalI ([x,p] uexistsI (f x) urefl))
      (isrightuniqueI ([x,y,z,p] (eq/sym (p andEl)) eq/trans (p andEr)))❙
❚

theory SetBase =
  include ?SetDefinitions❙
  include ?ExtensionalityAx❙
  include ?SubsetDefinitions❙

  // UniverseNonEmpty is used instead of ExistenceAx❙
  include ?UniverseNonEmpty❙
❚

</content>
</file>

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory PairingAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // The unordered pair {A,B} consists of exactly the two elements A and B❙
  isuopair = [A,B,Z] ∀ͧ[x] x∈Z ⇔ x =ͧ A ∨ x =ͧ B❙

  pairing_axiom : {A,B} ⊦ ∃ͧ[Z] isuopair A B Z❙
  pairing_unique : {A,B} ⊦ ∃ꜝͧ[Z] isuopair A B Z❘ 
    = [A,B] pairing_axiom uexistsE ([z,pz] uexistsUniqueI pz
      ([y,py] extensionalityI ([x] (pz uforallE x) equiv_equivalence/trans
      (equiv_equivalence/sym (py uforallE x)))))❙
  pairingAxI : {A,B,Z,x} ⊦ isuopair A B Z ⟶ ⊦ x =ͧ A ∨ x =ͧ B ⟶ ⊦ x∈Z❘
    = [A,B,Z,x,p,q] p uforallE x equivEr q❙
  pairingAxE : {A,B,Z,x,C} ⊦ isuopair A B Z ⟶ ⊦ x∈Z ⟶ (⊦ x =ͧ A ⟶ ⊦ C) ⟶ (⊦ x =ͧ B ⟶ ⊦ C) ⟶ ⊦ C❘# 7 pairingAxE 6 8 9❘
    = [A,B,Z,x,C,p,q,pa,pb] p uforallE x equivEl q orE pa pb❙
❚

theory UnionAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // The big union of a family of sets A consists of all the elements x of its sets X.❙
  isbigunion = [A,Z] ∀ͧ[x] x∈Z ⇔ ∃ͧ[X] X∈A ∧ x∈X❙

  union_axiom : {A} ⊦ ∃ͧ[Z] isbigunion A Z❙
  union_unique : {A} ⊦ ∃ꜝͧ[Z] isbigunion A Z❘
    = [A] union_axiom uexistsE ([z,pz] uexistsUniqueI pz
      ([y,py] extensionalityI ([x] (pz uforallE x) equiv_equivalence/trans
      (equiv_equivalence/sym (py uforallE x)))))❙
  unionAxI : {A,Z,X,x} ⊦ isbigunion A Z ⟶ ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈X ⟶ ⊦ x∈Z❘
    = [A,Z,X,x,p,pa,pb] p uforallE x equivEr (uexistsI X (andI pa pb))❙
  unionAxE : {A,Z,x} ⊦ isbigunion A Z ⟶ ⊦ x∈Z ⟶ ⊦ ∃ͧ[X] X∈A ∧ x∈X❘# 5 unionAxE 4❘
    = [A,Z,x,p,q] p uforallE x equivEl q❙
❚

theory PowersetAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // Each subset B of the set A is an element of the powerset Z❙
  ispowerset = [A,Z] ∀ͧ[B] B∈Z ⇔ (∀ͧ[x] x∈B ⇒ x∈A)❙

  powerset_axiom : {A} ⊦ ∃ͧ[Z] ispowerset A Z❙
  powerset_unique : {A} ⊦ ∃ꜝͧ[Z] ispowerset A Z❘
    = [A] powerset_axiom uexistsE ([z,pz] uexistsUniqueI pz
      ([y,py] extensionalityI ([B] (pz uforallE B) equiv_equivalence/trans
      (equiv_equivalence/sym (py uforallE B)))))❙
  powersetAxI : {A,B,Z} ⊦ ispowerset A Z ⟶ ({x} ⊦ x∈B ⇒ x∈A) ⟶ ⊦ B∈Z❘
    = [A,B,Z,p,q] p uforallE B equivEr (uforallI q)❙
  powersetAxE : {A,B,Z} ⊦ ispowerset A Z ⟶ ⊦ B∈Z ⟶ {x} ⊦ x∈B ⇒ x∈A❘# 5 powersetAxE 4 6❘
    = [A,B,Z,p,q,x] p uforallE B equivEl q uforallE x❙
❚

theory ComprehensionAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // The resulting set consists of all elements x of A that satisfy predicate P❙
  iscomprehension = [A,P,Z] ∀ͧ[x] x∈Z ⇔ x∈A ∧ (P x)❙

  comprehension_axiom : {A,P} ⊦ ∃ͧ[Z] iscomprehension A P Z❙
  comprehension_unique : {A,P} ⊦ ∃ꜝͧ[Z] iscomprehension A P Z❘
    = [A,P] comprehension_axiom uexistsE ([z,pz] uexistsUniqueI pz
      ([y,py] extensionalityI ([x] (pz uforallE x) equiv_equivalence/trans
      (equiv_equivalence/sym (py uforallE x)))))❙
  comprehensionAxI : {A,P,Z,x} ⊦ iscomprehension A P Z ⟶ ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ P x ⟶ ⊦ x∈Z❘
    = [A,P,Z,x,p,pa,pb] p uforallE x equivEr (andI pa pb)❙
  comprehensionAxEl : {A,P,Z,x} ⊦ iscomprehension A P Z ⟶ ⊦ x∈Z ⟶ ⊦ x∈A❘# 6 comprehensionAxEl 5❘
    = [A,P,Z,x,p,q] p uforallE x equivEl q andEl❙
  comprehensionAxEr : {A,P,Z,x} ⊦ iscomprehension A P Z ⟶ ⊦ x∈Z ⟶ ⊦ P x❘# 6 comprehensionAxEr 5❘
    = [A,P,Z,x,p,q] p uforallE x equivEl q andEr❙
❚

theory ReplacementAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?RelationDefinitions❙
  
  // The resulting set is a replacement for A regarding function f❙
  isreplacement = [f,A,Z] ∀ͧ[y] y∈Z ⇔ (∃ͧ[x] x∈A ∧ f x y)❙  

  replacement_axiom : {f} ⊦ ∀ͧ[A] isfunction f A ⇒ ∃ͧ[Z] isreplacement f A Z❙
  replacement_unique : {f,A} ⊦ isfunction f A ⟶ ⊦ ∃ꜝͧ[Z] isreplacement f A Z❘
    = [f,A,p] replacement_axiom uforallE A implE p uexistsE ([z,pz] uexistsUniqueI pz
      ([y,py] extensionalityI ([x] (pz uforallE x) equiv_equivalence/trans
      (equiv_equivalence/sym (py uforallE x)))))❙
  // AS: do I need isfunction f A here?❙
  replacementAxI : {f,A,Z,y} ⊦ isfunction f A ⟶ ⊦ isreplacement f A Z ⟶ ⊦ (∃ͧ[x] x∈A ∧ f x y) ⟶ ⊦ y∈Z❘
    = [f,A,Z,y,pf,pr,q] pr uforallE y equivEr q❙
  replacementAxE : {f,A,Z,y,C} ⊦ isfunction f A ⟶ ⊦ isreplacement f A Z ⟶ ⊦ y∈Z ⟶ ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ f x y ⟶ ⊦C) ⟶ ⊦C❘# 8 replacementAxE 6 7 9❘
    = [f,A,Z,y,C,pf,pr,q,Q] pr uforallE y equivEl q uexistsE ([x,px] Q x (px andEl) (px andEr))❙ 
❚

theory RegularityAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // Every set has a "smallest" element❙
  isregular = ∀ͧ[A](∃ͧ[u] u∈A) ⇒ ∃ͧ[B] B∈A ∧ ¬(∃ͧ[x] x∈A ∧ x∈B)❙

  regularity_axiom : ⊦ isregular❙
❚

// AS: These are special cases of regularity. Maybe it should be moved to a file

      ([tb] symdifIr tb (symdifIr (notI ([pf3] (pb andEl) notE (symdifIr tb pf3))) (pb andEr)))))
      ([q] q symdifE ([qa] tnd orE ([tc] symdifIr (notI ([pf4] pf4 symdifE 
      ([pfa4] (qa andEr) notE (symdifIr (pfa4 andEr) tc) inconE) ([pfb4] (pfb4 andEl) notE (qa andEl) inconE) falseE)) tc)
      ([td] symdifIl (symdifIl (qa andEl) notI ([pf5] (qa andEr) notE (symdifIl pf5 td))) td))
