namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory TheRelation =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?RelationDefinitions❙
  
  // A specific relation on the sets A and B which fulfills some predicate P❙
  theRel: set ⟶ set ⟶ (set ⟶ set ⟶ prop) ⟶ set❙
  inRel : set ⟶ set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❙
    
  // auxiliary function to check whether a set is a relation of A B❙
  // AS: note that it is not possible to define this similar as in ordered pairs.
      isrelAB = [R,A,B] ∃[P] R =ͧ theRel A B P does not work in FOL!❙
  // A single relation is a subset of the CartesianProduct.❙
  isrelAB : set ⟶ set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❙
  
  // computation rule❙
  compRel : {A,B,P,a,b} ⊦ inRel (theRel A B P) a b ⇔ a∈A ∧ b∈B ∧ P a b❙
  
  // representation rule❙
  reprRel : {A,B,R} ⊦ isrelAB R A B ⟶ ⊦ R =ͧ theRel A B ([x,y] inRel R x y)❙
  
  // extensionality rule❙
  extRel : {A,B,R,S} ⊦ isrelAB R A B ⟶ ⊦ isrelAB S A B ⟶ ({x,y} ⊦ inRel R x y ⇔ inRel S x y) ⟶ ⊦ R =ͧ S❙
  
  // just a helper to specify isrightunique❙
  isrightu : set ⟶ prop❘
    = [R] isrightunique (inRel R)❙
  // just a helper to specify islefttotal❙
  isleftt : set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘
    = [R,A] islefttotal (inRel R) A❙
    
  // auxiliary function to check, whether a set is a pfunc❙
  ispfuncAB : set ⟶ set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘
    = [R,A,B] isrelAB R A B ∧ isrightu R❙
    
  isfuncAB : set ⟶ set ⟶ set ⟶ prop❘
    = [R,A,B] isrelAB R A B ∧ isrightu R ∧ isleftt R A❙
❚

theory Relations =
  include ?TheRelation❙

  // The set of all relations is the powerset of the CartesianProduct❙
  // The set of all relations of A and B❙
  rel : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❙

  relI : {A,B,P} ⊦ theRel A B P ∈ rel A B❘# relI 3❙  
  relE : {A,B,R} ⊦ R ∈ rel A B ⟶ ⊦ isrelAB R A B❘# 4 relE❙
  
  rel_sub : {A,B,C,D} ⊦ A⊆C ⟶ ⊦ B⊆D ⟶ ⊦ rel A B ⊆ rel C D❙
❚

theory PartialFunctions =
  include ?TheRelation❙

  // The set of all partial functions of A and B. Partial functions are 
    relations that are right unique.❙
  pfunc : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❙

  // introduction and elimination rule for the set of all partial functions of X and Y❙
  pfuncI : {A,B,P} ⊦ isrightu (theRel A B P) ⟶ ⊦ theRel A B P ∈ pfunc A B❘# pfuncI 3 4❙    
  pfuncE : {A,B,R} ⊦ R ∈ pfunc A B ⟶ ⊦ ispfuncAB R A B❘# 4 pfuncE❙
❚

theory Functions =
  include ?TheRelation❙

  // The set of all functions of X and Y. Functions are partial functions that
   are left total.❙
  func : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❙

  // introduction and elimination rule for the set of all functions of X and Y❙
  funcI : {A,B,P} ⊦ isrightu (theRel A B P) ⟶ ⊦ isleftt (theRel A B P) A ⟶ ⊦ theRel A B P ∈ func A B❘# funcI 3 4❙
  funcE : {A,B,R} ⊦ R ∈ func A B ⟶ ⊦ isfuncAB R A B❘# 4 funcE❙
❚

// AS: Lambda shall later be used to formalize function_types. However, the defintion of 
  lambda s.t. it is usable for function_types is harder than expected❚
theory LambdaFunction =
  // Formalization of lambda function❙
  include ?TheRelation❙
  // lambda A f = {(x,ͧf(x)) : x∈A}❙
  lambda : set ⟶ (set ⟶ set) ⟶ set❘# λͧ 1 2 prec 40❙
  apply : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# 1 @ͧ 2 prec 50❙
  
  // computation rule❙
  beta : {A,f,x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ (λͧ A f)@ͧx =ͧ f x❙
  // representation rule❙
  eta : {A,B,F} ⊦ isfuncAB F A B ⟶ ⊦ F =ͧ λͧ A ([x] F@ͧx)❙
  // extensionality rule❙
  ext : {A,B,F,G} ⊦ isfuncAB F A B ⟶ ⊦ isfuncAB G A B ⟶ ([x] ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ F@ͧx =ͧ G@ͧx) ⟶ ⊦ F=ͧG❙
❚

theory LambdaImage =
  include ?LambdaFunction❙
  include ?Image❙
  // Lambda is just a relation❙
  lambda_rel : {A,f} ⊦ λͧ A f =ͧ theRel A (image f A) (fun2rel f)❙
  // AS: maybe use the fact that F is a function and therefore there has to be a unique b❙
  // apply_inrel : {F,a} ⊦ isfuncAB F A B ⟶ ⊦ F@ͧa =ͧ the ([b] inRel F a b) (right_unique)❙
  // This has to be correct, but is it useful?
  // apply_inrel : {F,a,b} ⊦ F@ͧa =ͧ b ⇔ inRel F a b❙

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory OrderedPairs =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // (a,b)❙
  pair : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# 1 ,ͧ 2 prec 50❙
  // first projection of a pair❙
  pi1 : set ⟶ set❘# 1 ₁ͧ prec 60❙
  pi2 : set ⟶ set❘# 1 ₂ͧ prec 60❙

  ispair : set ⟶ prop❘
    = [p] ∃ͧ[a] ∃ͧ[b] p =ͧ (a,ͧb)❙
  pair_is_pair : {a,b} ⊦ ispair (a,ͧb)❘
    = [a,b] uexistsI a (uexistsI b urefl)❙

  // computation rules❙
  // AS: add role Simplify here if wanted. I made the proofs before I knew of Simplify
    and didn't want to change them later.❙
  compL : {a,b} ⊦ (a,ͧb)₁ͧ =ͧ a❙
  compR : {a,b} ⊦ (a,ͧb)₂ͧ =ͧ b❙

  // representation rule❙
  repr : {p} ⊦ ispair p ⟶ ⊦ p =ͧ (p₁ͧ,ͧp₂ͧ)❘
    = [p,pp] pp uexistsE ([a,pa] pa uexistsE ([b,pb] pb eq/trans
      (((eq/sym pb) ucongP ([C] (C₁ͧ) =ͧ a) compL) ucongP ([C] (C,ͧb) =ͧ (p₁ͧ,ͧp₂ͧ))
      (((eq/sym pb) ucongP ([C] (C₂ͧ) =ͧ b) compR) ucongP ([C] (p₁ͧ,ͧC) =ͧ (p₁ͧ,ͧp₂ͧ)) urefl))))❙

  // extensionality rule❙
  ext : {p,q} ⊦ ispair p ⟶ ⊦ ispair q ⟶ ⊦ p₁ͧ =ͧ q₁ͧ ⟶ ⊦ p₂ͧ =ͧ q₂ͧ ⟶ ⊦ p =ͧ q❘
    = [p,q,pp,qq,pa,pb] (pa ucongP ([C] p =ͧ (C,ͧq₂ͧ)) (pb ucongP ([C] p =ͧ (p₁ͧ,ͧC)) (repr pp)))
      eq/trans (eq/sym repr qq)❙

  // injective❙
  pair_inj : {A,B,C,D} ⊦ (A,ͧB) =ͧ (C,ͧD) ⟶ ⊦ A =ͧ C ∧ B =ͧ D❘
    = [A,B,C,D,p] andI ((eq/sym compL) eq/trans ((eq/sym p) ucongP ([X] (X₁ͧ) =ͧ C) compL))
      ((eq/sym compR) eq/trans ((eq/sym p) ucongP ([X] (X₂ͧ) =ͧ D) compR))❙
❚

theory Img =
  include ?OrderedPairs❙
  // img R a = {b | (a,ͧb)∈R}❙
  img : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❙
  imgI : {R,a,b} ⊦ (a,ͧb)∈R ⟶ ⊦ b ∈ img R a❙
  imgE : {R,a,b} ⊦ b ∈ img R a ⟶ ⊦ (a,ͧb)∈R❘# 4 imgE❙
❚

theory CartesianProduct =
  include ?OrderedPairs❙

  // symbol: jtimes❙
  prod : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# 1 ×ͧ 2 prec 50❙

  // introduction and elimination rules❙
  prodI : {A,B,a,b} ⊦ a∈A ⟶ ⊦ b∈B ⟶ ⊦ (a,ͧb) ∈ A×ͧB❙
  prodEl : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ A×ͧB ⟶ ⊦ p₁ͧ∈A❘# 4 prodEl❙
  prodEr : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ A×ͧB ⟶ ⊦ p₂ͧ∈B❘# 4 prodEr❙

  prodE : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ A×ͧB ⟶ ⊦ ispair p❘# 4 prodE❙
  
  prod_sub : {A,B,C,D} ⊦ A⊆C ⟶ ⊦ B⊆D ⟶ ⊦ A×ͧB ⊆ C×ͧD❘
    = [A,B,C,D,pa,pb] subsetI ([x,p] eq_in (repr (p prodE)) 
      prodI (p prodEl subsetE pa) (p prodEr subsetE pb))❙
❚

// The Cartesian product with an empty set results in the empty set❚
theory CartEmpty =
  include ?CartesianProduct❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  cart_emptyA : {B} ⊦ ∅×ͧB =ͧ ∅❘
    = [B] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] empty_prop notE (uexistsI (x₁ͧ) (p prodEl)) inconE)
      ([q] empty_prop notE (uexistsI x q) inconE))❙
  cart_emptyB : {A} ⊦ A×ͧ∅ =ͧ ∅❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] empty_prop notE (uexistsI (x₂ͧ) (p prodEr)) inconE)
      ([q] empty_prop notE (uexistsI x q) inconE))❙
❚

theory CartInter =
  include ?CartesianProduct❙
  include ?Intersection❙
  
  cart_interBC : {A,B,C} ⊦ A×ͧ(B∩C) =ͧ (A×ͧB)∩(A×ͧC)❘
    = [A,B,C] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] eq_in (repr (p prodE)) (interI (prodI (p prodEl) ((p prodEr) interEl))
      (prodI (p prodEl) ((p prodEr) interEr))))
      ([q] eq_in (repr (q interEl prodE)) (prodI (q interEl prodEl)
      (interI (q interEl prodEr) (q interEr prodEr)))))❙
      
  cart_inter : {A,B,C,D} ⊦ (A×ͧB)∩(C×ͧD) =ͧ (A∩C)×ͧ(B∩D)❘
    = [A,B,C,D] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] eq_in (repr (p interEl prodE)) (prodI (interI (p interEl prodEl)
      (p interEr prodEl)) (interI (p interEl prodEr) (p interEr prodEr))))
      ([q] eq_in (repr (q prodE)) (interI (prodI (q prodEl interEl)
      (q prodEr interEl)) (prodI (q prodEl interEr) (q prodEr interEr)))))❙
❚

theory CartUnion =
  include ?CartesianProduct❙
  include ?Union❙
  
  cart_unionBC : {A,B,C} ⊦ A×ͧ(B∪C) =ͧ (A×ͧB)∪(A×ͧC)❘
    = [A,B,C] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] eq_in (repr (p prodE)) (p prodEr unionE 
      ([pa] unionIl (A×ͧC) (prodI (p prodEl) pa))
      ([pb] unionIr (A×ͧB) (prodI (p prodEl) pb))))
      ([q] q unionE ([qa] eq_in (repr (qa prodE))
      (prodI (qa prodEl) (unionIl C (qa prodEr))))
      ([qb] eq_in (repr (qb prodE)) 
      (prodI (qb prodEl) (unionIr B (qb prodEr))))))❙
❚

theory Sigma =
  // sigma or dependent product❙
  include ?OrderedPairs❙
  
  sigma : set ⟶ (set ⟶ set) ⟶ set❘# Σͧ 1 2 prec 40❙
  
  sigmaI : {A,B,a,b} ⊦ a∈A ⟶ ⊦ b∈(B a) ⟶ ⊦ (a,ͧb) ∈ Σͧ A B❙
  sigmaEl : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ Σͧ A B ⟶ ⊦ p₁ͧ∈A❘# 4 sigmaEl❙
  sigmaEr : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ Σͧ A B ⟶ ⊦ p₂ͧ∈(B (p₁ͧ))❘# 4 sigmaEr❙
  
  sigmaE : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ Σͧ A B ⟶ ⊦ ispair p❘# 4 sigmaE❙
  
  sigma_sub : {A,B,C} ⊦ A⊆C ⟶ ⊦ Σͧ A B ⊆ Σͧ C B❘
    = [A,B,C,p] subsetI ([x,q] eq_in (repr (q sigmaE))
      (sigmaI (q sigmaEl subsetE p) (q sigmaEr)))❙
❚

theory SigmaEmpty =
  include ?Sigma❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  sigma_emptyA : {B} ⊦ Σͧ ∅ B =ͧ ∅❘
    = [B] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] empty_prop notE (uexistsI (x₁ͧ) (p sigmaEl)) inconE)
      ([q] empty_prop notE (uexistsI x q) inconE))❙
  sigma_emptyB : {A} ⊦ Σͧ A ([x] ∅) =ͧ ∅❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] empty_prop notE (uexistsI (x₂ͧ) (p sigmaEr)) inconE)
      ([q] empty_prop notE (uexistsI x q) inconE))❙
❚

theory SigmaMod =
  // modified version of sigma that contains an additional proof❙
  include ?OrderedPairs❙
  
  sigmaMod : {A: set} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ set) ⟶ set❘# Σͧ 1 2 prec 40❙
  
  sigmaModI : {A,B,a,b} {p: ⊦ a∈A} ⊦ b∈(B a p) ⟶ ⊦ (a,ͧb) ∈ Σͧ A B❙
  sigmaModEl : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ Σͧ A B ⟶ ⊦ p₁ͧ∈A❘# 4 sigmaModEl❙
  sigmaModEr : {A,B,p} {q: ⊦ p ∈ Σͧ A B} ⊦ p₂ͧ∈(B (p₁ͧ) (q sigmaModEl))❘# 4 sigmaModEr❙
  
  sigmaModE : {A,B,p} ⊦ p ∈ Σͧ A B ⟶ ⊦ ispair p❘# 4 sigmaModE❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory Powersets =
  include ?SetBase❙

  powerset : set ⟶ set❘# ℘ 1 prec 60❙
  powersetI : {A,B} ({x} ⊦ x∈B ⟶ ⊦ x∈A) ⟶ ⊦ B∈ ℘A❙
  powersetE : {A,B} ⊦ B∈ ℘A ⟶ {x} ⊦ x∈B ⟶ ⊦ x∈A❘# 3 powersetE 5❙
  
  // variant of powerset using subsets, which might be practical if the input is
    already a subset❙
  vpowersetI : {A,B} ⊦ B⊆A ⟶ ⊦ B∈ ℘A❘
    = [A,B,p] powersetI ([x,q] q subsetE p)❙
  vpowersetE : {A,B} ⊦ B∈ ℘A ⟶ ⊦ B⊆A❘# 3 vpowersetE❘
    = [A,B,p] subsetI ([x,q] p powersetE q)❙
  
  powerset_self : {A} ⊦ A ∈ ℘A❘
    = [A] vpowersetI subset_refl❙
❚

theory PowersetsEmpty =
  include ?Powersets❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  powerset_empty : {A} ⊦ ∅∈ ℘A❘
    = [A] vpowersetI empty_sub❙
❚

</content>

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory EmptySet =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
  
  // AS: These two could be in EmptyDefinitions as well. But they are mainly necessary to prove EmptySet
    therefore I put them here❙
  isempty_exists : ⊦ ∃ͧ isempty❙
  isempty_unique : ⊦ ∃ ꜝͧ isempty❘
    = isempty_exists uexistsE ([X,px] uexistsUniqueI px ([y,py] extensionalityI
      ([x] equivI ([pa] px notE (uexistsI x pa) inconE)
      ([pb] py notE (uexistsI x pb) inconE))))❙

  // symbol: jemptyset❙
  emptyset : set❘# ∅❘
    = the isempty isempty_unique❙
  empty_prop : ⊦ isempty ∅❘
    = the_ax isempty isempty_unique❙
  
  emptyI : {A} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ false) ⟶ ⊦ A =ͧ ∅❘
    = [A,p] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([pa] p x pa falseE inconE)
      ([pb] empty_prop notE uexistsI x pb inconE))❙
  emptyE : {x} ⊦ x∈∅ ⟶ ↯❘# 2 emptyE❘
    = [x,p] empty_prop isemptyE p❙
    
  empty_sub : {A} ⊦ ∅ ⊆ A❘
    = [A] subsetI ([x,p] empty_prop notE uexistsI x p inconE)❙
❚

theory Singletons =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  singleton : set ⟶ set❘# singleton 1 prec 100❙
  singletonI : {x} ⊦ x∈ singleton x❙
  singletonE : {A,x} ⊦ x∈ singleton A ⟶ ⊦ x =ͧ A❘# 3 singletonE❙
  
  issingleton : set ⟶ prop❘ = [A] ∃ꜝͧ[x] x∈A❙
  singleton_the : {A} ⊦ issingleton A ⟶ set❘ 
    = [A,p] the ([u] u∈A) p❙

  issingletonI : {A,B} ⊦ A =ͧ singleton B ⟶ ⊦ issingleton A❘
    = [A,B,p] eq/sym p ucongP ([X] issingleton X)
      (uexistsUniqueI singletonI ([C,q] eq/sym (q singletonE)))❙
  issingletonE : {A} ⊦ issingleton A ⟶ ⊦ ∃ͧ[X] A =ͧ singleton X❘# 2 issingletonE❘
    = [A,p] p uexistsUniqueE ([X,pa,pb] uexistsI X extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([qa] eq_in (eq/sym (pb x qa)) singletonI)
      ([qb] eq_in (qb singletonE) pa)))❙
  
  singleton_inj : {A,B} ⊦ singleton A =ͧ singleton B ⟶ ⊦ A =ͧ B❘
    = [A,B,p] in_eq singletonI p singletonE❙
❚

theory UnorderedPairs =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  uopair : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# uopair 1 2 prec 40❙
  uopairIl : {A,B} ⊦ A∈ uopair A B❙
  uopairIr : {A,B} ⊦ B∈ uopair A B❙
  uopairE  : {A,B,x,C} ⊦ x∈ uopair A B ⟶ (⊦ x =ͧ A ⟶ ⊦C) ⟶ (⊦ x =ͧ B ⟶ ⊦C) ⟶ ⊦C❘# 5 uopairE 6 7❙
  
  uopair_comm : {A,B} ⊦ uopair A B =ͧ uopair B A❘
    = [A,B] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] p uopairE ([pa] eq_in pa uopairIr) ([pb] eq_in pb uopairIl))
      ([q] q uopairE ([qa] eq_in qa uopairIr) ([qb] eq_in qb uopairIl)))❙
❚

</content>

<content>
namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory Union =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // symbol: jcup❙
  union : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# 1 ∪ 2 prec 40❙
  unionIl : {A,B,x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈A∪B❘ # unionIl 2 4❙
  unionIr : {A,B,x} ⊦ x∈B ⟶ ⊦ x∈A∪B❘ # unionIr 1 4❙
  unionE : {A,B,x,C} ⊦ x∈A∪B ⟶ (⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ C) ⟶ (⊦ x∈B ⟶ ⊦ C) ⟶ ⊦ C❘# 5 unionE 6 7❙ 

  union_subl : {A,B} ⊦ A ⊆ A∪B❘
    = [A,B] subsetI ([x,p] unionIl B p)❙
  union_subr : {A,B} ⊦ B ⊆ A∪B❘
    = [A,B] subsetI ([x,p] unionIr A p)❙
  union_sup : {A,B,C} ⊦ A⊆C ⟶ ⊦ B⊆C ⟶ ⊦ A∪B ⊆C❘
    = [A,B,C,pa,pb] subsetI ([x,p] p unionE ([qa] qa subsetE pa) ([qb] qb subsetE pb))❙
    
  union_idem : {A} ⊦ A∪A =ͧ A❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p unionE ([pa] pa) ([pb] pb)) ([q] unionIl A q))❙
  union_comm : {A,B} ⊦ A∪B =ͧ B∪A❘
    = [A,B] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p unionE ([pa] unionIr B pa) ([pb] unionIl A pb))
      ([q] q unionE ([qa] unionIr A qa) ([qb] unionIl B qb)))❙
  union_assoc : {A,B,C} ⊦ (A∪B)∪C =ͧ A∪(B∪C)❘
    = [A,B,C] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p unionE ([pab] pab unionE ([pa] unionIl (B∪C) pa)
      ([pb] unionIr A (unionIl C pb))) ([pc] unionIr A (unionIr B pc)))
      ([q] q unionE ([qa] unionIl C (unionIl B qa)) ([qbc] qbc unionE 
      ([qb] unionIl C (unionIr A qb)) ([qc] unionIr (A∪B) qc))))❙

  // This is only true, if A is a subset of U❙
  union_universe : {U,A} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈U) ⟶ ⊦ A∪U =ͧ U❘
    = [U,A,Q] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] p unionE ([pa] Q x pa) ([pb] pb)) ([q] unionIr A q))❙
❚

theory UnionEmpty =
  include ?Union❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  union_empty : {A} ⊦ A∪∅ =ͧ A❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] p unionE ([pa] pa) ([pb] empty_prop notE uexistsI x pb inconE))
      ([q] unionIl ∅ q))❙
❚

theory Intersection =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  inter : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# 1 ∩ 2 prec 40❙
  interI : {A,B,x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈B ⟶ ⊦ x∈A∩B❙
  interEl : {A,B,x} ⊦ x∈A∩B ⟶ ⊦ x∈A❘# 4 interEl❙
  interEr : {A,B,y} ⊦ y∈A∩B ⟶ ⊦ y∈B❘# 4 interEr❙
  
  inter_subl : {A,B} ⊦ A∩B ⊆A❘
    = [A,B] subsetI ([x,p] p interEl)❙
  inter_subr : {A,B} ⊦ A∩B ⊆B❘
    = [A,B] subsetI ([x,p] p interEr)❙
  inter_inf : {A,B,C} ⊦ C⊆A ⟶ ⊦ C⊆B ⟶ ⊦ C⊆(A∩B)❘
    = [A,B,C,pa,pb] subsetI ([x,p] interI (p subsetE pa) (p subsetE pb))❙

  inter_idem : {A} ⊦ A∩A =ͧ A❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p interEl) ([q] interI q q))❙
  inter_comm : {A,B} ⊦ A∩B =ͧ B∩A❘
    = [A,B] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] interI (p interEr) (p interEl))
      ([q] interI (q interEr) (q interEl)))❙
  inter_assoc : {A,B,C} ⊦ (A∩B)∩C =ͧ A∩(B∩C)❘
    = [A,B,C] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] interI (p interEl interEl) (interI (p interEl interEr) (p interEr)))
      ([q] interI (interI (q interEl) (q interEr interEl)) (q interEr interEr)))❙

  inter_universe : {U,A} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈U) ⟶ ⊦ A∩U =ͧ A❘
    = [U,A,Q] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] p interEl) ([q] interI q (Q x q)))❙
      
  // this does not work because all algebra theories are written relative to SFOL and we're in FOL❙ 
  // total structure algebra : algebraic?BoundedSemilattice =
  //   universe = set❙
  //   op = inter❙
  //   comm_ax = forallI [X] forallI [Y] extensionalityI ([p] interI (interER p) (interEL p)) (([p] interI (interER p) (interEL p)))❙
  // ❚
❚

theory IntersectionEmpty =
  include ?Intersection❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  inter_empty : {A} ⊦ A∩∅ =ͧ ∅❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p interEr) 
      ([q] empty_prop notE uexistsI x q inconE))❙
❚

theory BigUnion =
  include ?SetBase❙

  bigunion : set ⟶ set❘# ⋃ 1 prec 45❙
  bigunionI : {A,X,x} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈X ⟶ ⊦ x∈ ⋃A❙
  bigunionE : {A,x,C} ⊦ x∈⋃A ⟶ ({X}⊦X∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈X ⟶ ⊦C) ⟶ ⊦C❘# 4 bigunionE 5❙
  
  bigunion_sub : {A,X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ X⊆⋃A❘
    = [A,X,p] subsetI ([x,q] bigunionI p q)❙
  bigunion_sup : {A,B} ({X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ X⊆B) ⟶ ⊦ ⋃A⊆B❘
    = [A,B,p] subsetI ([x,q] q bigunionE ([X,qa,qb] qb subsetE p X qa))❙
❚

theory BigIntersection =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙

  biginter : set ⟶ set❘# ⋂ 1 prec 45❙
  // A must be nonempty because otherwise intersection would produce the set of all sets❙
  biginterI : {A,x} ⊦ nonempty A ⟶ ({X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈X) ⟶ ⊦ x∈⋂A❙
  biginterE : {A,X,x} ⊦ x∈⋂A ⟶ ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈X❘# 4 biginterE 5❙
  
  biginter_sub : {A,X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ ⋂A⊆X❘
    = [A,X,p] subsetI ([x,q] q biginterE p)❙
  biginter_inf : {A,C} ⊦ nonempty A ⟶ ({X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ C⊆X) ⟶ ⊦ C⊆⋂A❘
    = [A,C,pa,pb] subsetI ([x,p] biginterI pa ([X,q] p subsetE pb X q))❙
❚

theory Difference =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // symbol: jsetminus❙
  dif : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# 1 ∖ 2 prec 40❙
  difI : {A,B,x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ ¬ x∈B ⟶ ⊦ x ∈ A∖B❙
  difEl : {A,B,x} ⊦ x ∈ A∖B ⟶ ⊦ x∈A❘# 4 difEl❙
  difEr : {A,B,x} ⊦ x ∈ A∖B ⟶ ⊦ ¬ x∈B❘# 4 difEr❙
  
  dif_sub : {A,B} ⊦ A∖B ⊆A❘
    = [A,B] subsetI ([x,p] p difEl)❙
❚

theory DifferenceEmpty =
  include ?Difference❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  dif_empty : {A} ⊦ A∖∅ =ͧ A❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p difEl) 
      ([q] difI q (notI ([pf] empty_prop notE uexistsI x pf))))❙
  dif_id : {A} ⊦ A∖A =ͧ ∅❘
    = [A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p difEr notE (p difEl) inconE)
      ([q] empty_prop notE uexistsI x q inconE))❙
❚

theory DifferenceIntersection =
  include ?Difference❙
  include ?Intersection❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  dif_inter : {A,B} ⊦ A ∩ (B∖A) =ͧ ∅❘
    = [A,B] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] (p interEr) difEr notE (p interEl) inconE)
      ([q] empty_prop notE uexistsI x q inconE))❙
❚

theory Complement =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  // A should be a subset of U❙
  // symbol: jcomp❙
  comp : set ⟶ set ⟶ set❘# ∁ 1 2 prec 50❙
  compI : {U,A,x} ⊦ x∈U ⟶  ⊦ ¬ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈(∁U A)❙
  compEl : {U,A,x} ⊦ x∈(∁ U A) ⟶ ⊦ x∈U❘# 4 compEl❙
  compEr : {U,A,x} ⊦ x∈(∁ U A) ⟶ ⊦ ¬ x∈A❘# 4 compEr❙
  
  comp_sub : {U,A} ⊦ ∁ U A ⊆ U❘
    = [U,A] subsetI ([x,p] p compEl)❙

  // This is only true, if A is a subset of U❙  
  comp_id : {U,A} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈U) ⟶ ⊦ ∁ U (∁ U A) =ͧ A❘
    = [U,A,Q] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] dne notI ([pf] p compEr notE (compI (p compEl) pf))) 
      ([q] compI (Q x q) (notI ([pf] pf compEr notE q))))❙
  
  // This is only true, if A is a subset of U; this does not need to be
    explicitely defined for B, since B is defined as ∁ U A already❙
  comp_equality : {U,A,B} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈U) ⟶ ⊦ ∁ U A =ͧ B ⟶ ⊦ ∁ U B =ͧ A❘
    = [U,A,B,Q,p] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([pa] dne notI ([pf] ((eq/sym p) ucongP ([X] ¬x∈X) (pa compEr)) 
      notE (compI (pa compEl) pf)))
      ([pb] compI (Q x pb) (notI ([pf] (in_eq pf (eq/sym p) compEr) notE pb))))❙
❚

theory ComplementEmpty =
  include ?Complement❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  comp_empty : {U} ⊦ ∁ U ∅ =ͧ U❘
    = [U] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p compEl)
      ([q] compI q notI ([pf] empty_prop notE uexistsI x pf)))❙
  comp_universe : {U} ⊦ ∁ U U =ͧ ∅❘
    = [U] extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p compEr notE (p compEl) inconE)
      ([q] empty_prop notE (uexistsI x q) inconE))❙
❚

theory ComplementUnion =
  include ?Complement❙
  include ?Union❙
  
  // This is only true, if A is a subset of U❙
  comp_union : {U,A} ({x} ⊦ x∈A ⟶ ⊦ x∈U) ⟶ ⊦ A ∪ ∁ U A =ͧ U❘
    = [U,A,Q] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] p unionE ([pa] Q x pa) ([pb] pb compEl))
      ([q] tnd orE ([qa] unionIl (comp U A) qa) ([qb] unionIr A (compI q qb))))❙
❚

theory ComplementIntersection =
  include ?Complement❙
  include ?Intersection❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  
  comp_inter : {U,A} ⊦ A ∩ ∁ U A =ͧ ∅❘
    = [U,A] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
      ([p] (p interEr) compEr notE (p interEl) inconE) 
      ([q] empty_prop notE uexistsI x q inconE))❙
❚
</content>

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

// AS: This file was mainly from LATIN, but MMT can do this differently. Therefore this shall be ignored❚

theory TBigUnion =
  include ?TypeBase❙
  
  // symbol: jbigcup❙
  Bigunion : {A} (Elem A ⟶ set) ⟶ set❘# ⋃ 2❙
  BigunionI : {A,F,e: Elem A,x} ⊦ x ∈ F e ⟶ ⊦ x ∈ ⋃F❙
  BigunionE : {A,F,x,C} ⊦ x ∈ ⋃F ⟶ ({e: Elem A} ⊦ x∈ F e ⟶ ⊦ C) ⟶ ⊦ C❘# 4 BigunionE 5❙
❚

theory TBigIntersection =
  include ?TypeBase❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
  
  Biginter : {A} (Elem A ⟶ set) ⟶ set❘# ⋂ 2❙
  BiginterI : {A,F,x} ⊦ nonempty A ⟶ ({e: Elem A} ⊦ x∈ F e) ⟶ ⊦ x ∈ ⋂F❙
  BiginterE : {A,F,x} ⊦ x ∈ ⋂F ⟶ {e: Elem A} ⊦ x ∈ F e❘# 4 BiginterE❙
❚

theory TImage =
  include ?TypeBase❙
  
  Image : {A} (Elem A ⟶ set) ⟶ set❘# Image 2❙
  ImageI : {A,e: Elem A,F: (Elem A ⟶ set)} ⊦ (F e) ∈ Image F❙
  ImageE : {A,F: (Elem A ⟶ set),d: Elem (Image F),C} 
    ({e: Elem A} ⊦ F e =ͧ which d ⟶ ⊦ C) ⟶ ⊦ C❙
❚

theory TPowersets =
  include ?TypeBase❙

  include ?Powersets❙
  Powerset : set ⟶ type❘
    = [A] Elem (℘A)❙
  PowPowerset : set ⟶ type❘
    = [A] Powerset (℘A)❙
    
  In : {A} Elem A ⟶ Powerset A ⟶ prop❘# 2 ∈ͯ 3❘
    = [A,a,b] which a ∈ which b❙
  
  include ?Filter❙
  // note from Twelf: definitions type check but would cause ambiguous typing lateron❙
  // AS: those like "those elements, that satisfy F"❙
  those : {A} (Elem A ⟶ prop) ⟶ Powerset A❘# those 2❘
    = [A,F] elem (A|([x] x∈A ∧ͩ ([p] F (elem x p)))) (vpowersetI filter_sub)❙
  // AS: do this later❙
  // thoseI : {A,e: Elem A,F: Elem A ⟶ prop} ⊦ F e ⟶ ⊦ e ∈ͯ (those F)❘
  //  = [A,e,F,p] filterI (why e) (dandI (why e) (EqcongP F p))❙
  
  Equal : {A} Powerset A ⟶ Powerset A ⟶ prop❘# 2 =ͯ 3❘
    = [A,a,b] a Eq b❙
  
  Subset : {A} Powerset A ⟶ Powerset A ⟶ prop❘# 2 ⊆ͯ 3❘
    = [A,a,b] which a ⊆ which b❙
  SubsetI : {A,B,C} ({x: Elem A} ⊦ x∈ͯB ⟶ ⊦ x∈ͯC) ⟶ ⊦ B⊆ͯC❘
    // = [A,B,C,Q] subsetI [x,p] Q (elem x p)❘❙
    
  Subset_refl : {A,a: Powerset A} ⊦ a ⊆ͯ a❘
    = [A,a] subset_refl❙
  Subset_trans : {A,a: Powerset A,b,c} ⊦ a⊆ͯb ⟶ ⊦ b⊆ͯc ⟶ ⊦ a⊆ͯc❘
    = [A,a,b,c,p,q] subset_trans p q❙
  include ?SubsetExtensionality❙
  Subset_eq : {A,a: Powerset A,b} ⊦ a⊆ͯb ⟶ ⊦ b⊆ͯa ⟶ ⊦ a=ͯb❘
    = [A,a,b,p,q] subset_eq p q❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory NatNums =
  include ?UnionSingleton❙
  include ?BigIntersectionUnorderedPairs❙
  include ?Intersection❘ = ?IntersectionAsBigIntersection❙
  include ?Adjoin❘ = ?AdjoinUnion❙ // These could already be included in ZFFeatures.❙ 
  include ?ZFFeatures❙
	include ?SubsetExtensionality❙

  // successor function❙
  usucc : set ⟶ set❘ = [X] adjoin X X❙

  // some numbers❙
  uzero : set❘ = ∅❙
  uone : set❘ = usucc uzero❙
  utwo : set❘ = usucc uone❙

  // properties of the numbers❙
  include ?UnionEmpty❙
  one_prop : ⊦ uone =ͧ (singleton ∅)❘
    = union_comm ucongP ([x] x =ͧ (singleton ∅)) union_empty❙
  zero_neq_one : ⊦ uzero =ͧ uone ⟶ ⊦ false❘
    = [p] empty_prop isemptyE (in_eq adjoinIr (eq/sym p)) inconE❙
  two_eq : ⊦ utwo =ͧ uopair uzero uone❘
    = extensionalityI ([x] equivI ([p] p adjoinE 
      ([pa] eq_in ((in_eq pa one_prop) singletonE) uopairIl) 
      ([pb] eq_in pb uopairIr))
      ([q] q uopairE ([qa] eq_in qa (adjoinIl adjoinIr))
      ([qb] eq_in qb adjoinIr)))❙
  
  // A contains the (intended) natural numbers❙
  has_nats : set ⟶ prop❘
    = [A] uzero∈A ∧ ∀ͧ[X] X∈A ⇒ (usucc X) ∈A❙
    
  exists_infinite : ⊦ ∃ͧ[X] has_nats X❘
    = infinity_axiom❙
❚

theory Nats =
  include ?NatNums❙
  // A is a minimum set with property P❙ 
  is_minimum : set ⟶ (set ⟶ prop) ⟶ prop❘
    = [A,P] P A ∧ ∀ͧ[Z] P Z ⇒ A⊆Z❙
  // a minimum set is unique❙
  minimum_unique : {P} ⊦ (∃ͧ[A] is_minimum A P) ⟶ ⊦ ∃ꜝͧ[A] is_minimum A P❘
    = [P,p] p uexistsE ([x,px] uexistsUniqueI px ([y,py] extensionalityI
      ([z] equivI ([pa] pa subsetE (px andEr uforallE y implE (py andEl)))
      ([pb] pb subsetE (py andEr uforallE x implE (px andEl))))))❙
  
  // intersect_all is the intersection of all subsets of A containing the natural numbers❙
  intersect_all : set ⟶ set❘
    = [A] ⋂(℘A | has_nats)❙
  // the property of having zero and all successors is closed under intersection❙
  intersect_has_nats : {A} ⊦ nonempty A ⟶ ({X} ⊦ X∈A ⟶ ⊦ has_nats X) ⟶ ⊦ has_nats (⋂A)❘
    = [A,ne,Q] andI (biginterI ne ([X,p] Q X p andEl))
      (uforallI ([X] implI ([p] biginterI ne ([Y,q] (Q Y q andEr) uforallE X implE 
      (p biginterE q)))))❙
  
  // there is a smallest set containing zero and all successors❙
  minimum_has_nats : ⊦ ∃ͧ[X] is_minimum X has_nats❘
    = exists_infinite uexistsE [x][p: ⊦ has_nats x] (
                     lemma (nonempty ((℘ x) | has_nats))
                           (uexistsI x (filterI (vpowersetI subset_refl) p))
                     [lem] uexistsI (intersect_all x) (andI
                       (intersect_has_nats lem [a][q: ⊦ a ∈ ℘ x | has_nats] q filterEr)
                       (uforallI [z] implI [q: ⊦ has_nats z]
                         subset_trans
                           (biginter_sub
                             (filterI (vpowersetI inter_subl)
                                      (intersect_has_nats (uexistsI x uopairIl) (
                                         [a][r: ⊦ a ∈ uopair x z]
                                            r uopairE ([s: ⊦ a =ͧ x] (s ucongPr has_nats p))
                                                      ([s: ⊦ a =ͧ z] (s ucongPr has_nats q))
                                         )
                                      )
                             )
                           : ⊦ (intersect_all x) ⊆ (x ∩ z))
                           (inter_subr : ⊦ (x ∩ z) ⊆ z)
                       )
                     )
                   )❙
  
  // set for natural numbers❙
  nats : set❘
    = the ([X] is_minimum X has_nats) (minimum_unique minimum_has_nats)❙
  nats_prop : ⊦ is_minimum nats has_nats❘
    = the_ax ([X] is_minimum X has_nats) (minimum_unique minimum_has_nats)❙
    
  // Peano axioms❙
  peano_zero : ⊦ uzero ∈ nats❘
    = nats_prop andEl andEl❙
  peano_succ : ⊦ ∀ͧ[n] n∈nats ⇒ (usucc n) ∈ nats❘
    = nats_prop andEl andEr❙
  peano_wellfounded : ⊦ ¬ ∃ͧ[n] (usucc n) =ͧ uzero❘
    = notI ([pf] pf uexistsE ([n,p] empty_prop notE (uexistsI n (in_eq adjoinIr p)) inconE) falseE)❙
  // uses regularity❙
  peano_linear : {n,m} ⊦ (usucc n) =ͧ (usucc m) ⟶ ⊦ n =ͧ m❘
    = [n,m,p] (in_eq adjoinIr p) adjoinE ([pa] (in_eq adjoinIr (eq/sym p)) adjoinE
    ([qa] in_acyclic pa qa falseE inconE) ([qb] eq/sym qb)) ([pb] pb)❙

  peano_induction : {Phi} ⊦ Phi uzero ⟶ ({n} ⊦ n∈nats ⟶ ⊦ Phi n ⟶ ⊦ Phi (usucc n))
                       ⟶ ⊦ ∀ͧ[n] n∈nats ⇒ Phi n❘
     = [Phi,p,f]
       lemma (has_nats (nats | Phi))
             (andI (filterI peano_zero p)
                  (uforallI [y] implI [q: ⊦ y ∈ (nats | Phi)]
                    filterI (peano_succ uforallE y implE (q filterEl)) (f y (q filterEl) (q filterEr))
                  )
             )
       [lem1]
          lemma (nats ⊆ (nats | Phi)) (nats_prop andEr uforallE (nats | Phi) implE lem1)
          [lem2] 
            lemma (nats =ͧ (nats | Phi)) (subset_eq lem2 filter_sub)
            [lem3] uforallI [n] implI [nE] (in_eq nE lem3) filterEr❙
❚
</content>

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

// Some definitions are commented because they slow down type-checking.❚

// ZFBase now contains all standard axioms of ZF instead of just Extensionality
  and Existence.❚
theory ZFBase =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?PairingAx❙
  include ?UnionAx❙
  include ?PowersetAx❙
  include ?ComprehensionAx❙
  include ?ReplacementAx❙
  include ?RegularityAx❙
  // InfinityAx relies on Empty Set and should be added after defining Empty Set❙
❚

theory ZF =
  include ?ZFBase❙
  
  include ?UnorderedPairs❙// = ?UopairFromAxiom❙
  include ?BigUnion❙// = ?BigUnionFromAxiom❙
  include ?Powersets❙// = ?PowersetFromAxiom❙
  include ?Filter❙// = ?FilterFromAxiom❙
  include ?Replace❙// = ?ReplaceFromAxiom❙
  
  // Acyclic is a special case of RegularityAx❙
  // include ?RegularityUopair❙
  include ?Acyclic❙// = ?AcyclicUopair❙
  
  // Empty is necessary for InfinityAx.❙
  // include ?ExistFilter❙
  include ?EmptySet❙// = ?EmptyExistFilter❙
  
  include ?InfinityAx❙
❚

// ZF and features that can be built from ZF❚
theory ZFFeatures =
  include ?ZF❙

  // AS: There are many includes that I wish would not be necessary❙  
  // include ?BigUnionUnorderedPairs❙
  include ?Union❙// = ?UnionAsBigUnion❙
  
  // include ?BigUnionFilterEmptyDefinition❙
  include ?BigIntersection❙// = ?BigIntersectionFilter❙
  
  // include ?BigIntersectionUnorderedPairs❙
  include ?Intersection❙// = ?IntersectionAsBigIntersection❙
  
  include ?Difference❙// = ?DifFilter❙
  
  include ?Complement❙// = ?ComplementFilter❙
  
  // include ?UnionDifference❙
  include ?SymmetricDifference❙// = ?SymUnion❙

  include ?Singletons❙// = ?SelfPair❙
  
  // include ?UnionSingleton❙
  include ?Adjoin❙// = ?AdjoinUnion❙
  
  include ?Remove❙// = ?RemoveFilter❙
  
  include ?Image❙// = ?ImageReplace❙ 
  
  // pairs and so on. KuratowskiPairs lead to errors❙
  // include ?KuratowskiPairs❙
  
  // include ?OrderedBigUnionImage❙
  include ?CartesianProduct❙// = ?CartImage❙
  include ?Sigma❙// = ?SigmaUnion❙
  
  // include ?CartFilter❙
  include ?TheRelation❙// = ?TheCartFilter❙
  
  // include ?CartFilterPower❙
  include ?Relations❙// = ?RelCartFilter❙
  include ?PartialFunctions❙// = ?RelFilter❙
  include ?Functions❙// = ?FuncCartFilter❙
  
  // include ?TheBigCartFilterImage❙
  include ?LambdaFunction❙// = ?LambdaCartFilter❙
❚

theory ZFC = 
  include ?ZF❙
  include ?ChoiceAx❙
❚

theory ZFCFeatures =
  include ?ZFC❙
  include ?ZFFeatures❙
❚

// AS: maybe typed versions of ZFC have to be moved into a different file
  or they are unnecessary❚
theory TypedZF =
  include ?TypeBase❙
  include ?ZF❙
❚

theory TypedZFFeatures =
  include ?TypedZF❙
  include ?ZFFeatures❙
❚
</content>

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory KuratowskiPairs =
  // (a,b) = {{a}, {a, b}}❙
  include ?Singletons❙
  include ?UnorderedPairs❙
  include ?BigIntersection❙
  include ?BigUnion❙
  include ?Filter❙

  realize ?OrderedPairs❙
  pair = [a,b] uopair (singleton a) (uopair a b)❙
  pi1 = [p] ⋃(⋂p)❙
  pi2 = [p] ⋃(⋃p | ([b] ∃ͧ[a] uopair (singleton  a) (uopair a b) =ͧ p))❙
  
  // computation rules❙
  compL = [a,b] extensionalityI ([x] equivI 
    ([p] p bigunionE ([X,pa,pb] in_eq pb ((pa biginterE uopairIl) singletonE)))
    ([q] bigunionI (biginterI (uexistsI (singleton a) uopairIl) 
    ([X,r] r uopairE ([qa] in_eq singletonI (eq/sym qa)) 
    ([qb] in_eq uopairIl (eq/sym qb)))) q))❙

  // AS: probably this can be done more elegant, but I don't want to touch this❙	
  compR = [a,b] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
    ([p] p bigunionE ([X,pa,pb] (pa filterEl) bigunionE ([Y,qa,qb] qa uopairE
    ([ra: ⊦ Y =ͧ singleton a] tnd orE ([sa: ⊦ a =ͧ b] in_eq (in_eq pb ((in_eq qb ra) singletonE)) sa)
    ([sb: ⊦ ¬ a =ͧ b] (pa filterEr) uexistsE ([y,py] (in_eq uopairIr (eq/sym py)) uopairE
    ([ta: ⊦ uopair a b =ͧ singleton y] issingletonI ta uexistsUniqueE
    ([z,pz,qz] sb notE ((eq/sym (qz a uopairIl)) eq/trans (qz b uopairIr)) inconE))
    ([tb: ⊦ uopair a b =ͧ uopair y X] (in_eq uopairIr tb) uopairE
    ([ua: ⊦ b =ͧ y] in_eq uopairIl ((eq/sym ua) ucongP 
    ([z] uopair (singleton z) (uopair z X) =ͧ uopair (singleton a) (uopair a b)) py)
    uopairE ([va: ⊦ singleton  b =ͧ singleton a] sb notE (singleton_inj (eq/sym va)) inconE)
    ([vb: ⊦ singleton b =ͧ uopair a b] issingletonI (eq/sym vb) uexistsUniqueE
    ([z,pz,qz] sb notE ((eq/sym (qz a uopairIl)) eq/trans (qz b uopairIr)) inconE)))
    ([ub: ⊦ b =ͧ X] in_eq pb (eq/sym ub))))))
    ([rb: ⊦ Y =ͧ uopair a b] (in_eq qb rb) uopairE ([sa: ⊦ X =ͧ a] tnd orE ([ta: ⊦ a =ͧ b] in_eq (in_eq pb sa) ta)
    ([tb: ⊦ ¬ a =ͧ b] (pa filterEr) uexistsE ([y,py] (in_eq uopairIr (eq/sym py)) uopairE
    ([ua: ⊦ uopair a b =ͧ singleton y] issingletonI ua uexistsUniqueE
    ([z,pz,qz] tb notE ((eq/sym (qz a uopairIl)) eq/trans (qz b uopairIr)) inconE))
    ([ub: ⊦ uopair a b =ͧ uopair y X] (in_eq uopairIr ub) uopairE
    ([va: ⊦ b =ͧ y] in_eq uopairIl ((eq/sym va) ucongP 
    ([z] uopair (singleton  z) (uopair z X) =ͧ uopair (singleton a) (uopair a b)) py)
    uopairE ([wa: ⊦ singleton  b =ͧ singleton a] tb notE (singleton_inj (eq/sym wa)) inconE)
    ([wb: ⊦ singleton b =ͧ uopair a b] issingletonI (eq/sym wb) uexistsUniqueE
    ([z,pz,qz] tb notE ((eq/sym (qz a uopairIl)) eq/trans (qz b uopairIr)) inconE)))
    ([vb: ⊦ b =ͧ X] in_eq pb (eq/sym vb))))))
    ([sb: ⊦ X =ͧ b] in_eq pb sb)))))
    ([q] bigunionI (filterI (bigunionI uopairIr uopairIr) (uexistsI a urefl)) q))❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory WienerPairs =
  // (a,b) = {{{a},∅},{{b}}}❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
  include ?Singletons❙
  include ?UnorderedPairs❙
  include ?BigUnion❙
  include ?Filter❙

  realize ?OrderedPairs❙
  pair = [a,b] uopair (uopair (singleton a) ∅) (singleton (singleton b))❙
  pi1 = [p] ⋃(⋃(⋃p) | [a] ∃ͧ[b] uopair (uopair (singleton a) ∅) (singleton (singleton b)) =ͧ p)❙
  pi2 = [p] ⋃(⋃(⋃p) | [b] ∃ͧ[a] uopair (uopair (singleton a) ∅) (singleton (singleton b)) =ͧ p)❙

  // computation rules❙
  compL = [a,b] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
    ([p] p bigunionE ([X,pa,pb] (pa filterEl) bigunionE ([Y,qa,qb] qa bigunionE ([Z,ra,rb]
    ra uopairE ([sa] (in_eq rb sa) uopairE ([ta] in_eq pb ((in_eq qb ta) singletonE))
    ([tb] empty_prop notE (uexistsI X (in_eq qb tb)) inconE))
    ([sb] (pa filterEr) uexistsE ([y,py] (in_eq uopairIl (eq/sym py)) uopairE
    ([ta] (in_eq uopairIl ta) uopairE ([ua] in_eq pb (eq/sym (singleton_inj ua)))
    ([ub] empty_prop notE (uexistsI a (in_eq singletonI ub)) inconE))
    ([tb] (issingletonI tb) uexistsUniqueE ([z,pz,qz] empty_prop notE (uexistsI a
    (in_eq singletonI ((eq/sym (qz (singleton a) uopairIl)) eq/trans (qz ∅ uopairIr)))) inconE))))))))
    ([q] bigunionI (filterI (bigunionI (bigunionI uopairIl uopairIl) singletonI)
    (uexistsI b urefl)) q))❙

  compR = [a,b] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
    ([p] p bigunionE ([X,pa,pb] (pa filterEl) bigunionE ([Y,qa,qb] qa bigunionE ([Z,ra,rb]
    ra uopairE ([sa] (pa filterEr) uexistsE ([y,py] (in_eq uopairIr (eq/sym py)) uopairE
    ([ta] (issingletonI (eq/sym ta)) uexistsUniqueE ([z,pz,qz] empty_prop notE (uexistsI y
    (in_eq  singletonI ((eq/sym (qz (singleton y) uopairIl)) eq/trans (qz ∅ uopairIr)))) inconE))
    ([tb] in_eq pb (singleton_inj (singleton_inj (eq/sym tb))))))
    ([sb] in_eq pb ((in_eq qb ((in_eq rb sb) singletonE)) singletonE))))))
    ([q] bigunionI (filterI (bigunionI (bigunionI uopairIr singletonI) singletonI)
    (uexistsI a urefl)) q))❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

// AS: care, UnionFilter got defined in views_lattice_operations. So if this file gets renamed,
  the dependency might fail!❙

/T   The views currently still need single theories as a domain and codomain, which 
  forces us to provide spurious named theories. This should be refactored when
  multi-theory domains and codomains are possible.❚

// AS: This would belong in another file, but I cannot move it now❚
theory RegularityUopair =
  include ?RegularityAx❙
  include ?UnorderedPairs❙
❚

view AcyclicUopair : ?Acyclic → ?RegularityUopair =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  in_acyclic = [A,B,p,q] regularity_axiom uforallE (uopair A B) implE (uexistsI A uopairIl)
      uexistsE ([Z,pz] pz andEl uopairE
      ([pa] (pz andEr) notE (uexistsI B (andI uopairIr (in_eq q (eq/sym pa)))) inconE)
      ([pb] (pz andEr) notE (uexistsI A (andI uopairIl (in_eq p (eq/sym pb)))) inconE))❙
❚

// Views for Filter❚
view FilterFromAxiom : ?Filter → ?ComprehensionAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  filter = [A,P] the ([Z] iscomprehension A P Z) comprehension_unique❙	
  filterI = [A,P,x,p,q] comprehensionAxI (the_ax ([Z] iscomprehension A P Z) comprehension_unique) p q❙
  filterEl = [A,P,x,p] p comprehensionAxEl (the_ax ([Z] iscomprehension A P Z) comprehension_unique)❙
  filterEr = [A,P,x,p] p comprehensionAxEr (the_ax ([Z] iscomprehension A P Z) comprehension_unique)❙
❚

// Views for Replace❚
view ReplaceFromAxiom : ?Replace → ?ReplacementAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?RelationDefinitions❙
  
  replace = [A,f,p] the ([Z] isreplacement (fun2rel f) A Z) replacement_unique p❙
  replaceI = [A,f,x,p] replacementAxI isfun_fun2rel (the_ax ([Z] isreplacement (fun2rel f) A Z) 
    replacement_unique isfun_fun2rel) (uexistsI x (andI p urefl))❙
  replaceE = [A,f,y,C,p,Q] p replacementAxE isfun_fun2rel (the_ax ([Z] isreplacement (fun2rel f) A Z)
    replacement_unique isfun_fun2rel) Q❙
❚

// Views for Image❚
view ImageReplace : ?Image → ?Replace =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  image = [A,f] replace A f isfun_fun2rel❙
  imageI = [A,f,x,p] replaceI p❙
  imageE = [A,f,y,p] p replaceE ([x,pa,pb] uexistsI x (andI pa pb))❙
❚

// Views for SymmetricDifference❚
theory UnionDifference =
  include ?Difference❙
  include ?Union❙
❚

view SymUnion : ?SymmetricDifference → ?UnionDifference =	
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  symdif = [A,B] (A∖B) ∪ (B∖A)❙
  symdifIl = [A,B,x,p,q] unionIl (B∖A) (difI p q)❙
  symdifIr = [A,B,x,p,q] unionIr (A∖B) (difI q p)❙
  symdifE = [A,B,x,C,p,pa,pb] p unionE 
    ([qa] pa (andI (qa difEl) (qa difEr)))
    ([qb] pb (andI (qb difEr) (qb difEl)))❙
❚

theory UnionIntersectionDifference =
  include ?UnionDifference❙
  include ?Intersection❙
❚

view SymDifference : ?SymmetricDifference → ?UnionIntersectionDifference =
  // AS: this might not be needed since Intersection could be left out❙
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  symdif = [A,B] (A∪B) ∖ (A∩B)❙
  symdifIl = [A,B,x,p,q] difI (unionIl B p) (notI ([pf] q notE (pf interEr)))❙
  symdifIr = [A,B,x,p,q] difI (unionIr A q) (notI ([pf] p notE (pf interEl)))❙
  symdifE = [A,B,x,C,p,pa,pb] p difEl unionE 
    ([qa] pa andI qa (notI ([pf] (p difEr) notE (interI qa pf))))
    ([qb] pb andI (notI ([pf] (p difEr) notE (interI pf qb))) qb)❙
❚

view SymFilter : ?SymmetricDifference → ?UnionFilter =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  symdif = [A,B] (A∪B) | ([x] (x∈A ∧ ¬ x∈B) ∨ (¬ x∈A ∧ x∈B))❙
  symdifIl = [A,B,x,p,q] filterI (unionIl B p) ((andI p q) orIl)❙
  symdifIr = [A,B,x,p,q] filterI (unionIr A q) ((andI p q) orIr)❙
  symdifE = [A,B,x,C,p,pa,pb] p filterEr orE ([qa] pa qa) ([qb] pb qb)❙
❚

// Views for Adjoin❚
theory UnionSingleton =
  include ?Union❙
  include ?Singletons❙
❚

view AdjoinUnion : ?Adjoin → ?UnionSingleton =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  adjoin = [A,b] A ∪ (singleton b)❙
  adjoinIl = [A,b,x,p] unionIl (singleton b) p❙
  adjoinIr = [A,b] unionIr A singletonI❙
  adjoinE = [A,b,x,C,p,pa,pb] p unionE pa ([q] pb (q singletonE))❙
❚

// Views for Remove❚
view RemoveFilter : ?Remove → ?Filter =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  remove = [A,b] A | ([x] ¬ x =ͧ b)❙
  removeI = [A,b,x,p,q] filterI p q❙
  removeE = [A,b,x,p] andI (p filterEl) (p filterEr)❙
❚

theory SingletonDifference =
  include ?Difference❙
  include ?Singletons❙
❚

view RemoveDifference : ?Remove → ?SingletonDifference =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  remove = [A,b] A∖(singleton b)❙
  removeI = [A,b,x,p,q] difI p (notI ([pf] q notE (pf singletonE)))❙
  removeE = [A,b,x,p] andI (p difEl) (notI ([pf] (p difEr) notE (eq_in pf singletonI)))❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

/T   The views currently still need single theories as a domain and codomain, which 
  forces us to provide spurious named theories. This should be refactored when
  multi-theory domains and codomains are possible.❚

// Views for Union❚
theory BigUnionUnorderedPairs =
  include ?BigUnion❙
  include ?UnorderedPairs❙
❚

view UnionAsBigUnion : ?Union → ?BigUnionUnorderedPairs = 
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  union = [A,B] ⋃ uopair A B❙
  unionIl = [A,B,x,p] bigunionI uopairIl p❙
  unionIr = [A,B,y,p] bigunionI uopairIr p❙
  unionE = [A,B,x,C,p,pa,pb] p bigunionE ([X,qa,qb] qa uopairE
    ([q] pa (in_eq qb q)) 
    ([q] pb (in_eq qb q)))❙
❚

// Views for Intersection❚
theory BigIntersectionUnorderedPairs =
  include ?BigIntersection❙
  include ?UnorderedPairs❙
❚

view IntersectionAsBigIntersection : ?Intersection → ?BigIntersectionUnorderedPairs = 	
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  inter = [A,B] ⋂ uopair A B❙
  interI = [A,B,x,pa,pb] biginterI (uexistsI A uopairIl) ([X,q] q uopairE 
    ([qa] in_eq pa (eq/sym qa))
    ([qb] in_eq pb (eq/sym qb)))❙	
  interEl = [A,B,x,p] p biginterE uopairIl❙
  interEr = [A,B,y,p] p biginterE uopairIr❙
❚

theory UnionFilter =
  include ?Filter❙
  include ?Union❙
❚

view IntersectionFilter : ?Intersection → ?UnionFilter =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  inter = [A,B] A∪B | ([x] x∈A ∧ x∈B)❙
  interI = [A,B,x,p,q] filterI (unionIl B p) (andI p q)❙
  interEl = [A,B,x,p] p filterEr andEl❙
  interEr = [A,B,y,p] p filterEr andEr❙
❚

// Views for BigUnion❚
view BigUnionFromAxiom : ?BigUnion → ?UnionAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  bigunion = [A] the ([Z] isbigunion A Z) union_unique❙
  bigunionI = [A,X,x,p,q] unionAxI (the_ax ([Z] isbigunion A Z) union_unique) p q❙
  bigunionE = [A,x,C,p,q] (p unionAxE (the_ax ([Z] isbigunion A Z) union_unique))
    uexistsE ([X,P] q X (P andEl) (P andEr))❙
❚

// Views for BigIntersection❚
theory BigUnionFilterEmptyDefinition =
  include ?BigUnion❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
  include ?Filter❙
❚

view BigIntersectionFilter : ?BigIntersection → ?BigUnionFilterEmptyDefinition =	
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
  
  biginter = [A] ⋃A|[x]∀ͧ[X] X∈A ⇒ x∈X❙
  biginterI = [A,x,ne,P] filterI (nonemptyE ne ([X,p] bigunionI p (P X p))) (uforallI [X] implI P X)❙
  biginterE = [A,X,x,p,q] p filterEr uforallE X implE q❙
❚

// Views for Difference❚
view DifFilter : ?Difference → ?Filter =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  dif = [A,B] A | ([x] ¬ x∈B)❙
  difI = [A,B,x,p,q] filterI p q❙
  difEl = [A,B,x,p] p filterEl❙
  difEr = [A,B,x,p] p filterEr❙
❚

// Views for Complement❚
view ComplementFilter : ?Complement → ?Filter =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  comp = [U,A] U | ([x] ¬ x∈A)❙
  compI = [U,A,x,p,q] filterI p q❙
  compEl = [U,A,x,p] p filterEl❙
  compEr = [U,A,x,p] p filterEr❙
❚

view ComplementDifference : ?Complement → ?Difference =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  comp = [U,A] U∖A❙
  compI = [U,A,x,p,q] difI p q❙
  compEl = [U,A,x,p] p difEl❙
  compEr = [U,A,x,p] p difEr❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

/T   The views currently still need single theories as a domain and codomain, which 
  forces us to provide spurious named theories. This should be refactored when
  multi-theory domains and codomains are possible.❚
  
// Views for TheRelation❚
// AS: to keep consistency with ordered pairs, it might be wanted to realize TheRelation instead. 
  These views can be changed easily into a realize❚
theory CartFilter =
  include ?CartesianProduct❙
  include ?Filter❙
  include ?RelationDefinitions❙
❚

view TheCartFilter : ?TheRelation → ?CartFilter =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?RelationDefinitions❙
  
  theRel = [A,B,P] (A ×ͧ B) | ([p] P (p₁ͧ) (p₂ͧ))❙
  inRel = [R,a,b] (a,ͧb) ∈ R❙
    
  isrelAB = [R,A,B] R ⊆ A×ͧB❙
  
  compRel = [A,B,P,a,b] equivI
      ([p] andI (andI (compL ucongP ([x] x∈A) ((p filterEl) prodEl)) 
      (compR ucongP ([x] x∈B) ((p filterEl) prodEr)))
      (compL ucongP ([x] P x b) (compR ucongP ([y] P ((a,ͧb)₁ͧ) y) (p filterEr))))
      ([q] filterI (prodI (q andEl andEl) (q andEl andEr)) 
      ((eq/sym compL) ucongP ([x] P x ((a,ͧb)₂ͧ)) 
      ((eq/sym compR) ucongP ([y] P a y) (q andEr))))❙
  
  reprRel = [A,B,R,rr] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] filterI (p subsetE rr)
      (repr (p subsetE rr prodE) ucongP ([y] y∈R) p))
      ([q] (eq/sym repr (q filterEl prodE)) ucongP ([y] y∈R) (q filterEr)))❙
  
  extRel = [A,B,R,S,rr,rs,Q] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
      ([p] eq/sym repr (p subsetE rr prodE) ucongP ([u] u∈S)
      (Q (x₁ͧ) (x₂ͧ) equivEl (repr (p subsetE rr prodE) ucongP ([u] u∈R) p)))
      ([q] eq/sym repr (q subsetE rs prodE) ucongP ([u] u∈R)
      (Q (x₁ͧ) (x₂ͧ) equivEr (repr (q subsetE rs prodE) ucongP ([u] u∈S) q))))❙
❚

// Views for Relations❚
theory CartFilterPower =
  include ?CartFilter❙
  include ?Powersets❙
❚

view RelCartFilter : ?Relations → ?CartFilterPower =
  include ?TheRelation❘ = ?TheCartFilter❙

  rel = [A,B] ℘ (A ×ͧ B)❙
  relI = [A,B,P] vpowersetI filter_sub❙
  relE = [A,B,R,p] p vpowersetE❙
  
  rel_sub = [A,B,C,D,pa,pb] subsetI ([x,px] powersetI ([y,py] (px powersetE py)
      subsetE (prod_sub pa pb)))❙
❚

// Views for PartialFunctions❚
theory RelFilter =
  include ?Relations❙
  include ?Filter❙
❚

view PFuncRelFilter : ?PartialFunctions → ?RelFilter =
  // AS: TheRelation should have the same definition as in relations, but
    how can this be stated here?❙
  include ?TheRelation❙
  
  pfunc = [A,B] rel A B | ([R] isrightu R)❙
  pfuncI = [A,B,P,p] filterI (relI P) p❙
  pfuncE = [A,B,R,p] andI (p filterEl relE) (p filterEr)❙
❚

view PFuncCartFilter : ?PartialFunctions → ?CartFilterPower =
  include ?TheRelation❘ = ?TheCartFilter❙
  
  pfunc = [A,B] ℘ (A ×ͧ B) | ([R] isrightunique ([a,b] (a,ͧb) ∈ R))❙
  pfuncI = [A,B,P,p] filterI (vpowersetI filter_sub) p❙
  pfuncE = [A,B,R,p] andI (p filterEl vpowersetE) (p filterEr)❙
❚

// Views for Functions❚
view FuncRelFilter : ?Functions → ?RelFilter =
  // AS: TheRelation should have the same definition as in relations, 
    but how can this be stated here?❙
  include ?TheRelation❙

  func = [A,B] rel A B | ([R] isrightu R ∧ isleftt R A)❙
  funcI = [A,B,P,p,q] filterI (relI P) (andI p q)❙
  // AS: MMT acting weird!❙
  funcE = [A,B,R,p] andI (andI (p filterEl relE) (p filterEr andEl))
    (p filterEr andEr)❙
❚

theory PFuncFilter =
  include ?PartialFunctions❙
  include ?Filter❙
❚

view FuncPFuncFilter : ?Functions → ?PFuncFilter =
  // AS: TheRelation should have the same definition as in partial functions, 
  but how can this be stated here?❙
  include ?TheRelation❙

  func = [A,B] pfunc A B | ([R] isleftt R A)❙
  funcI = [A,B,P,p,q] filterI (pfuncI P p) q❙
  funcE = [A,B,R,p] andI (p filterEl pfuncE) (p filterEr)❙
❚

view FuncCartFilter : ?Functions → ?CartFilterPower =
  include ?TheRelation❘ = ?TheCartFilter❙ 
  
  func = [A,B] ℘ (A ×ͧ B) | ([R] isrightunique ([a,b] (a,ͧb) ∈ R) ∧
    (islefttotal ([a,b] (a,ͧb)∈R) A))❙
  funcI = [A,B,P,p,q] filterI (vpowersetI filter_sub) (andI p q)❙
  // AS: MMT acting weird!❙
  funcE = [A,B,R,p] andI (andI (p filterEl vpowersetE) (p filterEr andEl))
    (p filterEr andEr)❙
❚

// Views for LambdaFunction❚
theory TheBigCartFilterImage =
  include ?CartFilter❙
  include ?BigUnion❙
  include ?Image❙
  include ?Img❙
❚

view LambdaCartFilter : ?LambdaFunction → ?TheBigCartFilterImage =
  include ?TheRelation❘ = ?TheCartFilter❙
  
  lambda = [A,f] image ([x] x,ͧ f x) A❙
  apply = [F,a] ⋃(img F a)❙
  
  beta = [A,f,y,py] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
    ([p] p bigunionE ([X,pa,pb] pa imgE imageE uexistsE 
    ([z,pz] (pair_inj (pz andEr) andEl) ucongP ([u] x∈(f u))
    (in_eq pb (eq/sym (pair_inj (pz andEr) andEr))))))
    ([q] bigunionI (imgI (imageI py)) q))❙
  // eta = _ ❙
  // ext = _ ❙
❚

theory BigLambda =
  include ?TheBigCartFilterImage❙
  include ?LambdaFunction❙
❚

view TheLambda : ?LambdaImage → ?BigLambda =
  include ?LambdaFunction❘ = ?LambdaCartFilter❙
  include ?Image❙
  
  lambda_rel = [A,f] extensionalityI ([x] equivI
    ([p] p imageE uexistsE ([y,py] eq_in (eq/sym (py andEr))
    (filterI (prodI (py andEl) (imageI (py andEl))) 
    (((eq/sym compL) ucongP ([u] f u =ͧ f y) urefl) eq/trans (eq/sym compR)))))
    ([q] eq_in (repr (q filterEl prodE)) ((q filterEr) ucongP
    ([z] (x₁ͧ,ͧz)∈image([u] u,ͧf u) A) (imageI (q filterEl prodEl)))))❙
❚
</content>

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

/T   The views currently still need single theories as a domain and codomain, which 
  forces us to provide spurious named theories. This should be refactored when
  multi-theory domains and codomains are possible. ❚
  
// Views for EmptySet❚
theory ExistFilter =
  include ?Filter❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
❚

view EmptyExistFilter : ?EmptySet → ?ExistFilter =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
  
  isempty_exists = univ_nonempty ([X] dne notI ([pf] tnd orE
    ([pa] pa uexistsE ([y,py] py filterEr notE urefl inconE))
    ([pb] pf notE (uexistsI (filter X ([z] ¬z =ͧ z)) pb) inconE) falseE))❙ 
❚

theory ComplementIntersection =
 	include ?Complement❙
 	include ?Intersection❙
 	include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
❚

view EmptyIntersection : ?EmptySet → ?ComplementIntersection =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
  
  isempty_exists = univ_nonempty ([X] univ_nonempty ([U] 
    dne notI ([pf] tnd orE ([pa] pa uexistsE ([y,py] (py interEr) compEr notE (py interEl) inconE))
    ([pb] pf notE (uexistsI (X ∩ (∁ U X)) pb) inconE) falseE)))❙ 
❚

theory ExistDifference =
  include ?Difference❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
❚

view SelfDifference : ?EmptySet → ?ExistDifference =
  include ?SetBase❙
  include ?EmptyDefinitions❙
  
  isempty_exists = univ_nonempty ([X] dne notI ([pf] tnd orE
    ([pa] pa uexistsE ([y,py] (py difEr) notE (py difEl) inconE))
    ([pb] pf notE (uexistsI (dif X X) pb) inconE) falseE))❙
❚

// Views for Singletons❚
view SelfPair : ?Singletons → ?UnorderedPairs =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  singleton = [A] uopair A A❙
  singletonI = [A] uopairIl❙
  singletonE = [A,x,p] p uopairE ([q] q) ([q] q)❙
❚

theory EmptyAdjoin =
  include ?Adjoin❙
  include ?EmptySet❙
❚

view SingleAdjoin : ?Singletons → ?EmptyAdjoin =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  singleton = [A] adjoin ∅ A❙
  singletonI = [x] adjoinIr❙
  singletonE = [A,x,p] p adjoinE ([pa] empty_prop notE (uexistsI x pa) inconE) ([pb] pb)❙
❚

// Views for Uopairs❚
view UopairFromAxiom : ?UnorderedPairs → ?PairingAx =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  uopair = [A,B] the ([Z] isuopair A B Z) pairing_unique❙
  uopairIl = [x,B] pairingAxI (the_ax ([Z] isuopair x B Z) pairing_unique) (urefl orIl)❙
  uopairIr = [A,y] pairingAxI (the_ax ([Z] isuopair A y Z) pairing_unique) (urefl orIr)❙
  uopairE = [A,B,x,C,p,pa,pb] p pairingAxE (the_ax ([Z] isuopair A B Z) pairing_unique) pa pb❙
❚

theory SingletonUnion =
  include ?Singletons❙
  include ?Union❙
❚

view UopairUnion : ?UnorderedPairs → ?SingletonUnion =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  uopair = [A,B] (singleton A) ∪ (singleton B)❙
  uopairIl = [x,B] unionIl (singleton B) singletonI❙
  uopairIr = [A,y] unionIr (singleton A) singletonI❙
  uopairE = [A,B,x,C,p,pa,pb] p unionE ([qa] pa (qa singletonE)) ([qb] pb (qb singletonE))❙
❚

theory AdjoinSingletons =
  include ?Adjoin❙
  include ?Singletons❙
❚

view UopairAdjointSingleton : ?UnorderedPairs → ?AdjoinSingletons =
  include ?SetBase❙
  
  uopair = [A,B] adjoin (singleton A) B❙
  uopairIl = [x,B] adjoinIl singletonI❙
  uopairIr = [A,y] adjoinIr❙
  uopairE = [A,B,x,C,p,pa,pb] p adjoinE ([q] pa (q singletonE)) pb❙
❚

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

/T   The views currently still need single theories as a domain and codomain, which 
  forces us to provide spurious named theories. This should be refactored when
  multi-theory domains and codomains are possible.❚

// Views for Img❚
theory OrderedImageFilter =
  include ?OrderedPairs❙
  include ?Image❙
  include ?Filter❙
❚

view ImgOrderedImageFilter : ?Img → ?OrderedImageFilter =
  include ?OrderedPairs❙
  img = [R,a] image ([p] p₂ͧ) (R|([x] ispair x ∧ (x₁ͧ)=ͧa))❙
  imgI = [R,a,b,p] compR ucongP ([x] x∈(image ([p] p₂ͧ) (R|([z] ispair z ∧ (z₁ͧ)=ͧa)))) 
      (imageI (filterI p (andI pair_is_pair compL)))❙
  imgE = [R,a,b,p] p imageE uexistsE ([x,px] (px andEr) ucongP ([z] (a,ͧz)∈R)
      ((px andEl filterEr andEr) ucongP ([y] (y,ͧ(x₂ͧ))∈R)

namespace latin:/❚

fixmeta ?DependentFOLEQDescND❚

theory TypedPredicateSubtypesSet =
  // AS: Propositions and Proofs are part of the fixmeta❙
  include ?Propositions❙
  include ?Proofs❙
  
  include ?TypedLogicSet❙
  include ?TypedEqualitySet❙  
  include ?Filter❙

  realize ?TypedPredicateSubtypes❙
  
  predsub = [A,P: Elem A ⟶ prop] filter A ([x] x∈A ∧ͩ ([p] P (elem x p)))❙
  // predsubI = [A,P,e: Elem A,p] elem (which e) filterI (why e) (dandI (why e) (ceq_which EqcongEr P p))❙
  predsubI = [A,P,e: Elem A,p] elem (which e) filterI (why e) (dandI (why e) (simpP P equivEl p))❙
  predsubEl = [A,P,e] elem (which e) ((why e) filterEl)❙
  predsubEr = [A,P,e] (why e) filterEr dandEr❙
  
  predsubElBeta = [A,P,a: Elem A,p: ⊦ P a] eq/refl ❙
  // [A,P,a: Elem A,p: ⊦ P a] (eq_which ((why (elem (which a) 
    filterI (why a) (dandI (why a) (ceq_which EqcongEr P p)))) filterEl)) eq/trans
    (eq_which (filterI (why a) (dandI (why a) (ceq_which EqcongEr P p))))❙
  
  // AS: Simplify is missing❙
❚

theory SoftTypedPredicateSubtypesSet =
  // AS: Propositions, Terms and Proofs are part of the fixmeta❙
  include ?Propositions❙
  include ?Terms❙
  include ?Proofs❙
  
  include ?SoftTypedLogicSet❙
  include ?Filter❙
  
  realize ?SoftTypedPredicateSubtypes❙
  // AS: not sure, if this is really just filter❙
  predsub = [A,P] filter A P❙
  predsubI = [A,P,x,p: ⊦ x∈A,q] filterI p q❙
  predsubEl = [A,P,x,p] p filterEl❙
  predsubEr = [A,P,x,p] p filterEr❙
❚

  include ?Propositions❙
  include ?Proofs❙
  // AS: part of fixmeta❙
  include ?Equivalence❙
  include ?EquivalenceNDI❙
  include ?EquivalenceNDE❙
  
  include ?TypedEqualityNDSet❙
  include ?Powersets❙
  
  realize powertypes/?PowerTypes❙
  power = powerset❙
  
  Powerset : set ⟶ type❘
    = [A] Elem (℘A)❙
    
  in = [A,a,b] which a ∈ which b❙
  
  include ?Filter❙
  pfilter = [A,P: Elem A ⟶ prop] elem (A|([x] x∈A ∧ͩ ([p] P (elem x p))))
      (vpowersetI filter_sub)❙
      
  compute = [A,P: Elem A ⟶ prop,e: Elem A] equivI 
    ([p] simpP P equivEr (p filterEr dandEr))
    ([q] filterI (why e) (dandI (why e) (simpP P equivEl q)))❙
    
  // expand = [A,S: Powerset A] _❙

  include ?TypedUniversalQuantificationNDSet❙
